Day 1：入籍誓詞 + 公民權利與義務

對應官方章節：The Oath of Citizenship、Rights and Responsibilities of Citizenship 建議閱讀：PDF p.2–p.9

今日重點

1. 入籍誓詞 The Oath of Citizenship（必背！口試會被問）

I swear (or affirm) that I will be faithful and bear true allegiance to His Majesty King Charles the Third, King of Canada, His Heirs and Successors, and that I will faithfully observe the laws of Canada, including the Constitution, which recognizes and affirms the Aboriginal and treaty rights of First Nations, Inuit and Métis peoples, and fulfil my duties as a Canadian citizen.

關鍵字記法：How to remember it:

  • King Charles the Third（不是 Queen Elizabeth；2022 年起換新國王）King Charles the Third — not Queen Elizabeth; Canada has had a new king since 2022
  • 誓詞包括憲法 the ConstitutionThe oath covers the Constitution as well as the laws
  • 承認並確認三類原住民的條約權利：First Nations、Inuit、MétisIt recognizes and affirms the Aboriginal and treaty rights of First Nations, Inuit and Métis peoples

2. 加拿大的法律基礎

  • 來自 英國憲政傳統 ＋ 法國民法 (Quebec) ＋ 英國普通法Canadian law flows from the British constitutional tradition, French civil law (Quebec) and English common law
  • 法治 Rule of Law：政府與人民都受法律約束Rule of Law: governments and citizens alike are bound by the law
  • 1982 年憲法 包含《權利與自由憲章 Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms》The Constitution of 1982 contains the Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms

3. 權利的四個來源

  1. Magna Carta 大憲章 (1215)Magna Carta, the Great Charter of Freedoms (1215)
  2. 英國權利請願書 1689 Bill of RightsThe English Bill of Rights of 1689
  3. 習慣法 Habeas Corpus（任意拘禁的人有上法庭的權利）Habeas corpus, from English common law — the right to challenge unlawful detention in court
  4. 1982 年加拿大權利與自由憲章The Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms, 1982

4. 憲章保障的 4 大基本自由 Fundamental Freedoms

  1. 良知與宗教自由Freedom of conscience and religion
  2. 思想、信仰、意見、言論自由（含新聞自由）Freedom of thought, belief, opinion and expression, including freedom of speech and of the press
  3. 和平集會自由Freedom of peaceful assembly
  4. 結社自由Freedom of association

5. 公民的權利 Rights

  • 動議自由 Mobility Rights：在加拿大內居住、工作Mobility rights: to live and work anywhere in Canada
  • 原住民人民權利Aboriginal Peoples' rights
  • 官方語言權利：英文／法文Official language rights: English and French
  • 少數族裔語言教育權Minority language educational rights
  • 多元文化遺產權Multiculturalism, a fundamental characteristic of the Canadian heritage

6. 公民的 6 大責任 Responsibilities（這條超常考！）

  1. 守法Obeying the law
  2. 照顧自己與家庭Taking responsibility for oneself and one's family
  3. 服務陪審團Serving on a jury
  4. 投票Voting in elections
  5. 協助社區Helping others in the community
  6. 保護並享受加拿大遺產與環境Protecting and enjoying our heritage and environment

7. 男女平等

  • 加拿大法律承認 男女法律平等Canadian law recognizes the equality of women and men
  • 配偶虐待、榮譽暴力、強迫婚姻、女性割禮 在加拿大屬於 刑事犯罪Spousal abuse, "honour killings", forced marriage and female genital mutilation are crimes in Canada

今日驗收題（20 題）

請先寫答案在另一張紙，做完再看下方「答案與解析」。Write your answers on a separate sheet first, then open the answers below.

  1. 在加拿大入籍誓詞中，公民效忠的對象是誰？In the Oath of Citizenship, to whom do you pledge your allegiance?
  2. 入籍誓詞特別承認哪 3 類原住民的條約權利？Which three Aboriginal peoples' treaty rights does the oath recognize?
  3. 加拿大的法律系統由哪三個傳統匯流而成？Which three legal traditions come together in Canadian law?
  4. 「Rule of Law」中文是什麼？意義為何？What does "Rule of Law" mean?
  5. 1982 年加拿大憲法中包含什麼重要文件？Which important document is part of the Constitution of 1982?
  6. 列出加拿大《權利與自由憲章》保障的 4 大基本自由。List the four fundamental freedoms protected by the Charter.
  7. 「習慣法 Habeas Corpus」保障人民什麼權利？What right does habeas corpus protect?
  8. 列出加拿大公民的 6 大責任。List the six responsibilities of a Canadian citizen.
  9. 哪一項是「責任」而非「權利」：投票／接受醫療／言論自由？Which one is a responsibility rather than a right: voting, receiving health care, or freedom of speech?
  10. 「服務陪審團」屬於權利還是責任？Is serving on a jury a right or a responsibility?
  11. 加拿大男女是否在法律上平等？Are women and men equal under Canadian law?
  12. 配偶虐待、強迫婚姻在加拿大是民事或刑事問題？Are spousal abuse and forced marriage civil or criminal matters in Canada?
  13. Magna Carta 是哪一年訂立的？In what year was Magna Carta signed?
  14. 公民的官方語言權利是哪兩種語言？Which two official languages do language rights cover?
  15. 「Mobility Rights」指什麼權利？What are mobility rights?
  16. 入籍誓詞中提到的國王是誰？Which king is named in the Oath of Citizenship?
  17. 言論自由包不包含新聞自由？Does freedom of expression include freedom of the press?
  18. 多元文化遺產屬於權利還是責任？Is the multicultural heritage a right or a responsibility?
  19. 公民有沒有「不工作的權利」？Is there a "right not to work" in the Charter?
  20. 投票屬於公民責任，那同樣居住在加拿大的「永久居民」可以投票嗎？Voting is a citizen's responsibility — may a permanent resident vote?
答案與解析（點擊展開）
  1. King Charles the Third（查理三世）及其繼承人。2022 年 9 月伊莉莎白二世過世，誓詞已更新為 King Charles the Third。His Majesty King Charles the Third, King of Canada, His Heirs and Successors. The wording changed after Queen Elizabeth II died in September 2022.
  2. First Nations（第一民族）、Inuit（因紐特）、Métis（梅蒂斯）。First Nations, Inuit and Métis peoples.
  3. 英國憲政傳統 ＋ 英國普通法 ＋ 法國民法（主要適用於 Quebec）。The British constitutional tradition, English common law, and French civil law — which is used in Quebec.
  4. 法治。意即沒有人可以凌駕於法律之上，政府也受法律約束。The Rule of Law. It means no person is above the law; governments are bound by it too.
  5. 《加拿大權利與自由憲章》。The Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms.
  6. 良知與宗教自由；思想、信仰、意見、言論（含新聞）自由；和平集會自由；結社自由。Freedom of conscience and religion; freedom of thought, belief, opinion and expression including the press; freedom of peaceful assembly; freedom of association.
  7. 被拘留的人可以請求出庭、挑戰拘留是否合法（防止任意拘禁）。The right to challenge unlawful detention by the state before a court.
  8. 守法；照顧自己與家庭；服務陪審團；投票；協助社區；保護並享受加拿大遺產與環境。Obeying the law; taking responsibility for oneself and one's family; serving on a jury; voting in elections; helping others in the community; protecting and enjoying our heritage and environment.
  9. 投票 是責任（同時也是權利）；言論自由是權利；接受醫療不在憲章層級。Voting is a responsibility as well as a right; freedom of speech is a right; health care is not a Charter freedom.
  10. 責任——而且只有公民才有這項義務。A responsibility, and one that only citizens carry.
  11. 是，法律上完全平等。Yes — women and men are equal under the law.
  12. 刑事犯罪。They are criminal offences.
  13. 1215 年。1215.
  14. English 和 French。English and French.
  15. 在加拿大境內任何地方居住、工作，以及出入境的權利。The right to live and work anywhere in Canada, and to enter and leave the country.
  16. King Charles the Third（查理三世）。King Charles the Third.
  17. 包含。Yes, it does.
  18. 權利。A right.
  19. 沒有這項憲法保障——但也沒有人可以強迫你做特定工作。No, the Charter contains no such right — but no one can force you into a particular job either.
  20. 不可以。投票權只給公民，永久居民還不行。No. Only citizens may vote; permanent residents may not.

  • [ ] 答對 ≥ 15／20 → 通過，明天進入 Day 215 or more correct — you pass; move on to Day 2 tomorrow
  • [ ] 答對 < 15／20 → 重讀官方 PDF p.2–p.9，明天再做一次同一份題目Fewer than 15 — reread pages 2 to 9 and take the same quiz again tomorrow

Day 2：我們是誰（人口、語言、原住民、多元文化）

對應官方章節：Who We Are 建議閱讀：PDF p.10–p.13

今日重點

1. 三大開國民族 Founding Peoples

加拿大由 三大民族 three founding peoples 共同建立：Canada was founded by three founding peoples:

  1. Aboriginal（原住民）Aboriginal peoples
  2. French（法裔）The French
  3. British（英裔）The British

2. 原住民 3 大類別（必背）

中文 英文 占原住民人口 居住地
第一民族 First Nations 約 65% 全國，常住保留區 reserves
因紐特 Inuit 約 4% 北極區（Arctic）
梅蒂斯 Métis 約 30% 草原省 (Prairies)，混血歐裔/原住民

歷史關鍵：Key moments:

  • 加拿大政府 1867 年起 與 First Nations 簽 條約 TreatiesFrom 1867 onward the government signed treaties with First Nations
  • 1800 年代到 1980 年代政府推行 寄宿學校 Residential Schools，造成文化斷裂From the 1800s to the 1980s the government ran residential schools, which cut children off from their culture
  • 2008 年 總理 Stephen Harper 代表政府 正式道歉In 2008 Prime Minister Stephen Harper made a formal apology on behalf of the government

3. 英裔與法裔

  • 法裔 francophones：約 800 萬人，多數在 QuebecFrancophones: about 8 million people, most of them in Quebec
  • 英裔 anglophones：以英文為母語者，約 1,800 萬人Anglophones: about 18 million people whose first language is English
  • Quebec 有八成講法語，是 北美最大的法語社區About 80% of Quebecers speak French — the largest French-speaking community in North America
  • Acadians：17 世紀起在大西洋省份的法裔居民Acadians are the descendants of French colonists who settled in the Atlantic provinces from the 1600s
  • Quebecers：Quebec 的居民Quebecers are the people who live in Quebec

4. 加拿大的雙語

  • 英文與法文同為官方語言English and French are the two official languages
  • 1969 年《官方語言法》Official Languages Act：保障兩種語言平等地位The Official Languages Act of 1969 gives the two languages equal status
  • 多數法裔住在 Quebec、新布藍瑞克北部、安大略東部與北部、曼尼托巴Most francophones live in Quebec, northern New Brunswick, eastern and northern Ontario, and Manitoba

5. 多元文化 Multiculturalism

  • 加拿大是 世界上最多元的國家之一Canada is one of the most diverse countries in the world
  • 大多數加拿大人 是移民或移民的後代Most Canadians are immigrants or the descendants of immigrants
  • 早期主要移民來自英國、愛爾蘭、法國The earliest immigrants came mainly from Britain, Ireland and France
  • 現在最大的移民來源是 亞洲（中國、印度、菲律賓）Today the largest source of newcomers is Asia — China, India and the Philippines
  • 1971 年由總理 Pierre Elliott Trudeau 推出多元文化主義，成為官方政策In 1971 Prime Minister Pierre Elliott Trudeau made multiculturalism official government policy

6. 主要宗教

  • 基督宗教是最大的宗教，其中天主教 Catholic 人數最多Christianity is the largest religion, with Catholics the biggest group
  • 其他還有伊斯蘭教、印度教、錫克教、佛教、猶太教Others include Islam, Hinduism, Sikhism, Buddhism and Judaism
  • 加拿大保障宗教自由Canada guarantees freedom of religion

7. 人口與大城市

  • 全國人口約 3,800 萬到 4,000 萬The population is about 38 to 40 million
  • 約八成的人住在城市About 80% of Canadians live in cities
  • 三大都會：Toronto 多倫多、Montreal 蒙特婁、Vancouver 溫哥華The three largest cities are Toronto, Montreal and Vancouver

今日驗收題（20 題）

  1. 加拿大的三大開國民族是哪三類？Who are the three founding peoples of Canada?
  2. 加拿大原住民分為哪三個主要群體？What are the three main groups of Aboriginal peoples?
  3. 哪一群原住民住在北極區？Which Aboriginal group lives in the Arctic?
  4. 哪一群原住民是歐裔與原住民的混血後代？Which group descends from both Aboriginal and European ancestors?
  5. 「Residential Schools」是什麼？造成什麼影響？What were the residential schools, and what was their effect?
  6. 加拿大政府在哪一年為寄宿學校正式道歉？由哪位總理代表？In what year did the government apologize for the residential schools, and which prime minister did it?
  7. 加拿大的兩種官方語言是什麼？What are Canada's two official languages?
  8. 哪一年通過《官方語言法》？In what year was the Official Languages Act passed?
  9. Quebec 的官方語言是什麼？What is the official language of Quebec?
  10. 「Acadians」是指什麼人？Who are the Acadians?
  11. 「Quebecers」是指什麼人？Who are Quebecers?
  12. 多元文化在哪一年成為官方政策？由哪位總理推動？In what year did multiculturalism become official policy, and under which prime minister?
  13. 加拿大最大的宗教傳統是什麼？What is the largest religious tradition in Canada?
  14. 加拿大人口大約多少？Roughly what is Canada's population?
  15. 加拿大三大都會是哪三個？What are Canada's three largest cities?
  16. 法裔人口大約多少？About how many francophones are there?
  17. 大多數加拿大人住在城市還是鄉村？Do most Canadians live in cities or in the countryside?
  18. 「First Nations」中文叫什麼？What does "First Nations" mean?
  19. 政府最早從哪一年開始與原住民簽訂條約？From what year did the government begin signing treaties with Aboriginal peoples?
  20. 在加拿大，所有人是否都必須信同一個宗教？Must everyone in Canada follow the same religion?
答案與解析（點擊展開）
  1. Aboriginal（原住民）、French（法裔）、British（英裔）。Aboriginal peoples, the French and the British.
  2. First Nations、Inuit、Métis。First Nations, Inuit and Métis.
  3. Inuit（因紐特）。The Inuit.
  4. Métis（梅蒂斯），主要住在草原省份。The Métis, who live mostly in the Prairie provinces.
  5. 1800 至 1980 年代政府強制原住民兒童入住的學校，禁止使用母語與傳統文化，造成嚴重創傷。Government-run schools from the 1800s to the 1980s that Aboriginal children were forced to attend; they were forbidden to speak their languages or practise their culture, and the harm was lasting.
  6. 2008 年，由總理 Stephen Harper 代表政府道歉。In 2008, by Prime Minister Stephen Harper on behalf of the government.
  7. English 和 French。English and French.
  8. 1969 年。1969.
  9. 法文 French——Quebec 是唯一以法文為唯一官方語言的省。French. Quebec is the only province whose sole official language is French.
  10. 17 世紀起在大西洋省份定居的法裔居民後代。The descendants of French colonists who settled in the Atlantic provinces from the 1600s.
  11. 居住在 Quebec 的人。The people who live in Quebec.
  12. 1971 年，由 Pierre Elliott Trudeau 推動。1971, under Pierre Elliott Trudeau.
  13. 基督宗教，其中以天主教人數最多。Christianity, with Catholics the largest group.
  14. 約 3,800 萬到 4,000 萬人。About 38 to 40 million.
  15. Toronto、Montreal、Vancouver。Toronto, Montreal and Vancouver.
  16. 約 800 萬人。About 8 million.
  17. 城市，約八成。In cities — about 80%.
  18. 第一民族。The first peoples of Canada, the largest of the three Aboriginal groups.
  19. 1867 年起，也就是邦聯之後。From 1867, that is, after Confederation.
  20. 不必。加拿大保障宗教自由。No. Canada guarantees freedom of religion.

Day 3：加拿大史 ①（早期 → 英法戰爭 1759）

對應官方章節：Canada’s History（前段） 建議閱讀：PDF p.14–p.16

今日重點

1. 名稱由來

  • 「Canada」來自 Iroquoian（易洛魁語）的「kanata」，意思是 「村莊 village」The name "Canada" comes from the Iroquoian word "kanata", meaning "village"
  • 1535 年探險家 Jacques Cartier 聽到原住民用這個字指稱聚落In 1535 the explorer Jacques Cartier heard the word used for a settlement

2. 早期探險（必記人名與年份）

年份 探險家 事蹟
~1000 Vikings 維京人 紐芬蘭 L’Anse aux Meadows 短暫定居
1497 John Cabot（義裔英國） 首位繪製加拿大東岸地圖的歐洲人
1534, 1535, 1541 Jacques Cartier（法國） 探勘聖羅倫斯灣，宣稱土地屬法王
1604 Pierre de Monts 建首個法裔殖民地 Port Royal（今新斯科細亞）
1608 Samuel de Champlain 創建 魁北克市 Québec City，被稱「新法蘭西之父」

3. 新法蘭西 New France（1608–1763）

  • 中心是 Québec CityIts centre was Québec City
  • 主要產業是 毛皮交易，特別是河狸皮The main industry was the fur trade, especially beaver pelts
  • 與 Algonquin、Huron 原住民結盟The French allied with the Algonquin and Huron peoples
  • 對手是與英國結盟的 Iroquois 易洛魁聯盟Their rivals were the Iroquois, who were allied with the British

4. 哈德遜灣公司 Hudson’s Bay Company（HBC）

  • 1670 年 由英王查理二世授權成立Chartered by King Charles II in 1670
  • 控制 Rupert&#x27;s Land 哈德遜灣集水區 的毛皮貿易It controlled the fur trade across Rupert's Land, the Hudson Bay watershed
  • 加拿大歷史上最古老的公司，至今仍在The oldest company in Canada, and it still exists today

5. 七年戰爭 / 英法戰爭

  • 1756 到 1763 年的全球戰爭A global war fought from 1756 to 1763
  • 1759 亞伯拉罕平原戰役 Battle of the Plains of AbrahamThe Battle of the Plains of Abraham, 1759
  • 戰場就在 Québec City 城外It was fought just outside Québec City
  • 英軍 General Wolfe 對法軍 General MontcalmThe British General Wolfe faced the French General Montcalm
  • 兩位將軍都陣亡Both generals died in the battle
  • 英國獲勝，新法蘭西落入英國手中Britain won, and New France passed into British hands
  • 1763 年《巴黎條約》Treaty of Paris：法國正式割讓加拿大給英國Under the Treaty of Paris of 1763 France formally ceded Canada to Britain

6. 英國統治後的安撫政策

  • 1774 年《魁北克法案》Quebec Act（極重要）The Quebec Act of 1774 — a key exam topic
  • 承認法語It allowed the French language
  • 承認天主教信仰It allowed the Catholic religion
  • 承認法國民法，用於私法事務It kept French civil law for private matters
  • 保障 Quebec 法裔身份不被同化It protected the French-Canadian identity from assimilation
  • 被視為現代加拿大寬容與多元的根基It is seen as the foundation of Canadian tolerance and diversity

7. 美國獨立的影響

  • 1775 到 1783 年的美國獨立戰爭The American Revolution, 1775 to 1783
  • 約四萬到五萬名 Loyalists 保皇黨 從美國北逃加拿大About 40,000 to 50,000 Loyalists fled north to Canada
  • 他們奠定了今天 New Brunswick 與 Ontario 的雛形They laid the foundations of today's New Brunswick and Ontario
  • 也帶來了大量英語人口They also brought a large English-speaking population

今日驗收題（20 題）

  1. 「Canada」一詞來自哪個原住民語言？意思是什麼？What Aboriginal language does the word "Canada" come from, and what does it mean?
  2. 最早抵達北美的歐洲人是哪一族？地點在哪？Who were the first Europeans to reach North America, and where did they land?
  3. John Cabot 是哪一年探勘加拿大東岸？In what year did John Cabot explore Canada's Atlantic shore?
  4. 哪位法國探險家在 1608 年建立魁北克市？Which French explorer founded Québec City in 1608?
  5. 為什麼 Samuel de Champlain 被稱為「新法蘭西之父」？Why is Samuel de Champlain called the Father of New France?
  6. 新法蘭西的主要經濟產業是什麼？What was the main industry of New France?
  7. 哪兩個原住民族與法國人結盟？Which two Aboriginal peoples allied with the French?
  8. 哈德遜灣公司哪一年成立？由誰授權？In what year was the Hudson's Bay Company founded, and who chartered it?
  9. 1759 年在魁北克市附近的關鍵戰役叫什麼名字？What was the key battle fought near Québec City in 1759?
  10. 那場戰役中英法兩位將軍分別是誰？結果如何？Who were the British and French generals in that battle, and what was the outcome?
  11. 哪一年簽訂《巴黎條約》，法國正式割讓加拿大？In what year did the Treaty of Paris transfer Canada to Britain?
  12. 1774 年《Quebec Act》保留了法裔的哪三項權利？Which three French-Canadian rights did the Quebec Act of 1774 protect?
  13. 為什麼《Quebec Act》在加拿大歷史上很重要？Why is the Quebec Act important in Canadian history?
  14. 美國獨立戰爭中逃到加拿大的英裔保皇黨叫什麼名字？What were the British-American refugees of the Revolution called?
  15. 大約多少名 Loyalists 逃到加拿大？About how many Loyalists came to Canada?
  16. Loyalists 主要落腳今天的哪兩個省份？Which two of today's provinces did the Loyalists mainly settle?
  17. 1497 年探勘加拿大東岸的義裔英國探險家是誰？Who was the Italian-born explorer who sailed for England in 1497?
  18. 易洛魁 Iroquois 與哪個歐洲強權結盟？Which European power were the Iroquois allied with?
  19. 「Rupert&#x27;s Land」是哪間公司的領地？Which company held Rupert's Land?
  20. Quebec City 是哪一年、由誰建立？In what year and by whom was Québec City founded?
答案與解析（點擊展開）
  1. Iroquoian 易洛魁語，意思是 「村莊 village」。The Iroquoian language; it means "village".
  2. 維京人 Vikings，約公元 1000 年在紐芬蘭的 L&#x27;Anse aux Meadows。The Vikings, around the year 1000, at L'Anse aux Meadows in Newfoundland.
  3. 1497 年。1497.
  4. Samuel de Champlain。Samuel de Champlain.
  5. 他建立魁北克市，讓法裔殖民地長期生存下來，奠定新法蘭西的基礎。He founded Québec City and made the French colony permanent, laying the foundation of New France.
  6. 毛皮交易，特別是河狸皮。The fur trade, especially beaver pelts.
  7. Algonquin 與 Huron。The Algonquin and the Huron.
  8. 1670 年，由 英王查理二世 Charles II 授權。1670, chartered by King Charles II.
  9. 亞伯拉罕平原戰役 Battle of the Plains of Abraham。The Battle of the Plains of Abraham.
  10. 英軍 General Wolfe、法軍 General Montcalm；兩人皆陣亡，英國獲勝。General Wolfe for Britain and General Montcalm for France; both died and Britain won.
  11. 1763 年。1763.
  12. 法語、天主教信仰、法國民法。The French language, the Catholic religion and French civil law.
  13. 它讓 Quebec 法裔保住語言、宗教與民法傳統，被視為加拿大寬容與多元的奠基石。It let French Canadians keep their language, religion and civil law, and is seen as the cornerstone of Canadian tolerance.
  14. Loyalists，也稱 United Empire Loyalists。The Loyalists, also called United Empire Loyalists.
  15. 約 四萬到五萬人。About 40,000 to 50,000.
  16. New Brunswick 與 Ontario。New Brunswick and Ontario.
  17. John Cabot，義大利名 Giovanni Caboto。John Cabot, born Giovanni Caboto.
  18. 英國。Britain.
  19. 哈德遜灣公司 Hudson&#x27;s Bay Company。The Hudson's Bay Company.
  20. 1608 年，由 Samuel de Champlain 建立。In 1608, by Samuel de Champlain.

  • [ ] 答對 ≥ 15／2015 or more correct
  • [ ] 記得這幾個關鍵年份：1497、1608、1670、1759、1763、1774You remember the key dates: 1497, 1608, 1670, 1759, 1763 and 1774
  • [ ] 說得出英法戰爭的關鍵戰役與結果You can name the decisive battle of the war and its outcome

Day 4：加拿大史 ②（1812 戰爭 → 邦聯 1867）

對應官方章節：Canada’s History（中段） 建議閱讀：PDF p.17–p.20

今日重點

1. 1812 年戰爭 War of 1812（必背！）

  • 加拿大對美國Canada against the United States
  • 美國想併吞英屬北美，入侵失敗The United States tried to conquer British North America and failed
  • Major-General Sir Isaac Brock 在 Queenston Heights 陣亡，被譽為「上加拿大的救星」Major-General Sir Isaac Brock was killed at Queenston Heights and is remembered as the Saviour of Upper Canada
  • Chief Tecumseh 是原住民領袖，與英軍同盟對抗美國Chief Tecumseh, a Shawnee leader, allied with the British against the Americans
  • Charles de Salaberry 在魁北克擊退美軍Charles de Salaberry turned back an American attack in Quebec
  • Laura Secord 步行 30 公里向英軍報信，是加拿大歷史最著名的女英雄Laura Secord walked 30 kilometres to warn the British, and is Canada's best-known heroine
  • 1813 年美軍焚毀 York，也就是今天的 TorontoIn 1813 American forces burned York, today's Toronto
  • 報復之下，1814 年英軍焚燒了華盛頓的白宮In return, in 1814 British troops burned the White House in Washington
  • 結果加拿大保住領土，今天的加美邊界由此確立Canada held its territory, and today's Canada-United States border dates from this war

2. 廢除奴隸制度

  • 1793 年 上加拿大由 Lieutenant Governor John Graves Simcoe 率先限制奴隸制In 1793 Lieutenant Governor John Graves Simcoe made Upper Canada the first province to move against slavery
  • 1834 年 大英帝國全面廢除奴隸制度，加拿大也在其中In 1834 slavery was abolished throughout the British Empire, Canada included
  • 地下鐵路 Underground Railroad 協助美國黑奴逃到加拿大獲得自由The Underground Railroad helped enslaved people escape from the United States to freedom in Canada

3. 1837–38 叛亂 The Rebellions

  • 在 上加拿大（今 Ontario） 與 下加拿大（今 Quebec） 同時發生They broke out in both Upper Canada, today's Ontario, and Lower Canada, today's Quebec
  • 領導人是 William Lyon Mackenzie 與 Louis-Joseph PapineauThe leaders were William Lyon Mackenzie and Louis-Joseph Papineau
  • 他們要求 責任政府，也就是內閣要對民選議會負責They demanded responsible government, meaning a cabinet answerable to the elected assembly
  • 叛亂失敗，卻促成了改革The rebellions failed, but they led to reform

4. 責任政府的誕生

  • 1840 年《統一法案》Act of Union 把上、下加拿大合併為「加拿大省」The Act of Union of 1840 joined Upper and Lower Canada into the Province of Canada
  • 1848 至 1849 年，Nova Scotia 與加拿大省出現加拿大第一個責任政府In 1848 and 1849 Nova Scotia and the Province of Canada won the first responsible government in Canada
  • 關鍵人物是 Robert Baldwin 與 Louis-Hippolyte LaFontaine 這對英法搭檔The key figures were Robert Baldwin and Louis-Hippolyte LaFontaine, an English-French partnership
  • Sir Louis-Hippolyte LaFontaine 是第一位由民選多數產生的政府首長Sir Louis-Hippolyte LaFontaine became the first head of a government chosen by an elected majority

5. 邦聯 Confederation 1867（最重要日期）

  • 1867 年 7 月 1 日《英屬北美法案 British North America Act》生效，加拿大誕生On July 1, 1867 the British North America Act took effect and Canada was born
  • 四個建國省份依序是 Ontario、Quebec、Nova Scotia、New BrunswickThe four founding provinces were Ontario, Quebec, Nova Scotia and New Brunswick
  • 首任總理是 Sir John A. Macdonald，$10 鈔票上的人The first prime minister was Sir John A. Macdonald, who appears on the ten-dollar bill
  • 他生於蘇格蘭，被稱為 加拿大國父Born in Scotland, he is known as a Father of Confederation
  • 國號是 Dominion of Canada 加拿大自治領The country was called the Dominion of Canada
  • 名字取自詩篇 72 篇 8 節，也成了國徽箴言 A Mari Usque Ad Mare，從海到海The name comes from Psalm 72:8 and gave Canada its motto, A Mari Usque Ad Mare — from sea to sea

6. 後續省份加入年份（記主要的）

年份 加入的省 / 領地
1870 Manitoba（曼尼托巴）、Northwest Territories
1871 British Columbia
1873 Prince Edward Island
1898 Yukon Territory
1905 Alberta、Saskatchewan
1949 Newfoundland and Labrador
1999 Nunavut

7. 重要早期領袖

  • Sir George-Étienne Cartier：法裔的邦聯之父，Macdonald 的搭檔Sir George-Étienne Cartier, the French-Canadian Father of Confederation and Macdonald's partner
  • Sir Étienne-Paschal Taché：早期的領袖之一Sir Étienne-Paschal Taché, another early leader
  • Sir Leonard Tilley（New Brunswick）：推動邦聯Sir Leonard Tilley of New Brunswick, who pushed for Confederation
  • Sir Charles Tupper（Nova Scotia）：推動邦聯Sir Charles Tupper of Nova Scotia, who did the same
  • Sir Wilfrid Laurier（1896–1911）：首位法裔總理，$5 鈔票上的人Sir Wilfrid Laurier, the first French-Canadian prime minister, on the five-dollar bill

今日驗收題（20 題）

  1. 1812 戰爭是加拿大與哪個國家作戰？In the War of 1812, whom did Canada fight?
  2. 誰被稱為「The Saviour of Upper Canada」？Who is called the Saviour of Upper Canada?
  3. Chief Tecumseh 站在哪一邊？他是什麼身份？Whose side was Chief Tecumseh on, and who was he?
  4. Laura Secord 做了什麼而成為歷史英雄？What did Laura Secord do that made her a hero?
  5. 1813 年美軍焚毀的城市叫什麼？是今天哪個城市？Which town did the Americans burn in 1813, and what is it called today?
  6. 1814 年英軍報復焚燒了哪一棟建築？Which building did the British burn in return in 1814?
  7. 大英帝國何時全面廢除奴隸制度？When was slavery abolished throughout the British Empire?
  8. 「Underground Railroad」是什麼？What was the Underground Railroad?
  9. 1837–38 叛亂的兩位領導人是誰？Who led the rebellions of 1837 and 1838?
  10. 他們要求的「Responsible Government」是什麼意思？What does responsible government mean?
  11. Baldwin 與 LaFontaine 在哪幾年達成責任政府？In what years did Baldwin and LaFontaine achieve responsible government?
  12. 加拿大邦聯是哪一年、哪一天？On what date was Confederation?
  13. 1867 年的四個建國省份是哪四個？Which four provinces formed Confederation in 1867?
  14. 加拿大首任總理是誰？Who was Canada's first prime minister?
  15. 「Dominion of Canada」這個名稱從哪裡來？Where does the name Dominion of Canada come from?
  16. 國徽箴言「A Mari Usque Ad Mare」是什麼意思？What does the motto A Mari Usque Ad Mare mean?
  17. Manitoba 與 Northwest Territories 哪一年加入？In what year did Manitoba and the Northwest Territories join?
  18. British Columbia 哪一年加入？In what year did British Columbia join?
  19. Newfoundland and Labrador 哪一年加入？In what year did Newfoundland and Labrador join?
  20. 加拿大第一位法裔總理是誰？Who was the first French-Canadian prime minister?
答案與解析（點擊展開）
  1. 美國。The United States.
  2. Major-General Sir Isaac Brock。Major-General Sir Isaac Brock.
  3. 站在 英國與加拿大這一邊；他是 Shawnee 原住民首領。He fought on the British and Canadian side; he was a Shawnee chief.
  4. 她步行約 30 公里，向英軍的 Lieutenant FitzGibbon 通報美軍動向，讓英軍得以設伏取勝。She walked about 30 kilometres to warn Lieutenant FitzGibbon of an American attack, allowing the British to win the ambush.
  5. York，今天的 Toronto。York, today's Toronto.
  6. 華盛頓的白宮 White House 以及其他政府建築。The White House in Washington, along with other government buildings.
  7. 1834 年。1834.
  8. 協助美國黑奴秘密逃往加拿大獲得自由的網絡，並不是真的鐵路。A secret network that helped enslaved people escape to freedom in Canada — not an actual railway.
  9. William Lyon Mackenzie 與 Louis-Joseph Papineau。William Lyon Mackenzie and Louis-Joseph Papineau.
  10. 指 內閣必須對民選議會負責，而不是只對總督負責。It means the cabinet must answer to the elected assembly, not only to the governor.
  11. 1848 到 1849 年：1848 是 Nova Scotia，1849 是加拿大省。1848 and 1849 — Nova Scotia in 1848, the Province of Canada in 1849.
  12. 1867 年 7 月 1 日。July 1, 1867.
  13. Ontario、Quebec、Nova Scotia、New Brunswick。Ontario, Quebec, Nova Scotia and New Brunswick.
  14. Sir John A. Macdonald。Sir John A. Macdonald.
  15. 來自聖經詩篇 72 篇 8 節「He shall have dominion also from sea to sea」。From Psalm 72:8, "He shall have dominion also from sea to sea."
  16. 從海到海。From sea to sea.
  17. 1870 年。1870.
  18. 1871 年。1871.
  19. 1949 年。1949.
  20. Sir Wilfrid Laurier，1896 到 1911 年任總理。Sir Wilfrid Laurier, prime minister from 1896 to 1911.

  • [ ] 記得 1812、1837、1848、1867、1870、1871、1949、1999 這幾個年份You remember 1812, 1837, 1848, 1867, 1870, 1871, 1949 and 1999
  • [ ] 記得首任總理 Macdonald 與首位法裔總理 LaurierYou remember Macdonald as the first prime minister and Laurier as the first French-Canadian one

Day 5：加拿大史 ③（邦聯後 → WWII）

對應官方章節：Canada’s History（後段） 建議閱讀：PDF p.21–p.24

今日重點

1. 加拿大太平洋鐵路 Canadian Pacific Railway (CPR)

  • 1885 年完工，把東岸和 British Columbia 連起來Completed in 1885, it linked the east to British Columbia
  • 修這條鐵路是 BC 加入邦聯的條件Building it was the condition on which BC joined Confederation
  • 約一萬五千名華工參與興建，許多人死於危險的工程About 15,000 Chinese workers built it, and many died doing dangerous work
  • 鐵路完工後，政府對華人移民課徵 人頭稅 Head TaxOnce the railway was done, the government imposed a head tax on Chinese immigrants
  • 2006 年總理 Stephen Harper 代表政府正式道歉In 2006 Prime Minister Stephen Harper apologized on behalf of the government

2. Métis 抵抗與 Louis Riel

  • Louis Riel 是 Métis 的領袖Louis Riel was the leader of the Métis
  • 他領導 1869 年紅河抵抗，促成 Manitoba 在 1870 年加入邦聯He led the Red River Resistance of 1869, which brought Manitoba into Confederation in 1870
  • 1885 年西北叛亂 戰敗，他被處以絞刑He was defeated in the North-West Rebellion of 1885 and hanged
  • 他至今仍是加拿大歷史上既受爭議又被紀念的人物He remains both a controversial and a celebrated figure in Canadian history

3. 婦女投票權（必背順序）

年份 事件
1916 Manitoba 首先給予婦女省級投票權（Nellie McClung 等推動）
1917 加拿大軍人的妻女取得聯邦投票權
1918 多數加拿大婦女取得聯邦投票權
1921 Agnes Macphail 成為史上首位女性國會議員 MP
1940 Quebec 婦女取得省級投票權（最晚）
1960 原住民 不必放棄條約身分即可投票

「The Famous Five」是五位婦女運動者，1929 年的「Persons Case」讓婦女在法律上被視為「人」，可被任命進入參議院。The Famous Five were five women whose 1929 Persons Case established that women are "persons" in law and may be appointed to the Senate.

4. WWI 第一次世界大戰 1914–1918

  • 超過六十萬名加拿大人服役More than 600,000 Canadians served
  • 約六萬人陣亡About 60,000 died
  • 1917 年維米嶺戰役 Vimy Ridge：加拿大軍團首次獨立作戰並獲勝，被視為民族認同的誕生At Vimy Ridge in 1917 the Canadian Corps fought as one and won — often called the birth of the nation
  • Sir Arthur Currie 是加拿大史上最傑出的軍人，指揮維米嶺Sir Arthur Currie, Canada's greatest soldier, commanded at Vimy
  • 軍醫 John McCrae 寫下名詩 《In Flanders Fields》，十一月的罌粟花由此而來The military doctor John McCrae wrote "In Flanders Fields", the source of the November poppy

5. 戰間期（1920–30 年代）

  • 1929 年開始的大蕭條 Great DepressionThe Great Depression began in 1929
  • 加拿大廣播公司 CBC 於 1936 年成立The Canadian Broadcasting Corporation was founded in 1936

6. WWII 第二次世界大戰 1939–1945

  • 加拿大在 1939 年 9 月自行對德宣戰，比英國晚一週，象徵外交獨立Canada declared war on Germany in September 1939, a week after Britain, as an independent country
  • 超過一百萬人服役More than a million Canadians served
  • 約四萬四千人陣亡About 44,000 died
  • 1942 年迪耶普戰役 Dieppe，加軍傷亡慘重At Dieppe in 1942 Canadian losses were heavy
  • 1943 年的義大利戰役The Italian campaign of 1943
  • 1944 年 6 月 6 日 D-Day 諾曼第登陸，加軍負責 Juno BeachOn D-Day, June 6, 1944, Canadians landed at Juno Beach
  • 1944 至 45 年解放荷蘭，荷蘭至今每年送鬱金香給加拿大Canadians liberated the Netherlands in 1944 and 1945; the Dutch still send tulips every year
  • 戰時 日裔加拿大人 被強制遷離 BC 沿岸並沒收財產During the war Japanese Canadians were moved away from the BC coast and their property was seized
  • 1988 年總理 Brian Mulroney 道歉並賠償In 1988 Prime Minister Brian Mulroney apologized and compensated them

7. 戰時婦女與工業

  • 戰時大量婦女進入工廠與軍隊Large numbers of women went into the factories and the forces during the war
  • 這段經驗改變了戰後婦女在職場的地位That experience changed women's place in the workforce after the war

答案與解析（點擊展開）
  1. 1885 年。1885.

  12. 服役 超過六十萬人，陣亡 約六萬人。More than 600,000 served and about 60,000 died.
  13. 維米嶺戰役 Vimy Ridge。The Battle of Vimy Ridge.
  14. John McCrae。John McCrae.

  16. 約 四萬四千人。About 44,000.
  17. Juno Beach。Juno Beach.

  19. 日裔加拿大人；1988 年由總理 Brian Mulroney 道歉。Japanese Canadians; Prime Minister Brian Mulroney apologized in 1988.
  20. 1936 年。1936.

Day 6：現代加拿大 + 1982 憲章

對應官方章節：Modern Canada 建議閱讀：PDF p.25–p.28

今日重點

1. 戰後重建與全球角色

  • 1945 年加拿大是聯合國 UN 的創始國Canada was a founding member of the United Nations in 1945
  • 1949 年加拿大是北約 NATO 的創始國Canada was a founding member of NATO in 1949
  • 1949 年紐芬蘭加入加拿大，成為第十個省Newfoundland joined Canada in 1949 as the tenth province
  • 韓戰 1950 至 1953 年，加拿大派出超過兩萬六千名軍人In the Korean War of 1950 to 1953 Canada sent more than 26,000 troops
  • 加拿大在國際上扮演 中型大國 middle power 的角色，長於調停與維和Canada acts as a middle power, known for mediation and peacekeeping

2. 維和 Peacekeeping

  • Lester B. Pearson 先是外交部長，後來成為總理Lester B. Pearson was foreign minister and later prime minister
  • 1956 年蘇伊士運河危機，他提議由聯合國派出 維和部隊 隔開衝突雙方In the Suez Crisis of 1956 he proposed a United Nations peacekeeping force to separate the sides
  • 1957 年他因此獲得諾貝爾和平獎He won the Nobel Peace Prize for it in 1957
  • 加拿大長期是聯合國維和的重要派兵國Canada has long been a major contributor to UN peacekeeping

3. 1965 國旗

  • 1965 年加拿大採用今天的 紅白楓葉旗In 1965 Canada adopted today's red and white maple leaf flag
  • 在那之前用的是帶英國米字的 Red EnsignBefore that it flew the Red Ensign, which carried the Union Jack

4. 1969 官方語言法

  • 由總理 Pierre Elliott Trudeau 推動Brought in by Prime Minister Pierre Elliott Trudeau
  • 英文與法文在聯邦層級地位平等English and French have equal status at the federal level

5. 1971 多元文化主義

  • Pierre Elliott Trudeau 宣布多元文化成為官方政策Pierre Elliott Trudeau made multiculturalism official government policy

6. 1982 憲法歸國 + 憲章（最重要）

  • 1982 年加拿大完成憲法歸國 Patriation of the ConstitutionIn 1982 Canada patriated its Constitution
  • 由 女王伊莉莎白二世 簽署It was signed by Queen Elizabeth II
  • 其中包含 《加拿大權利與自由憲章》It contains the Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms
  • 從此加拿大可自行修憲，不必再經英國國會From then on Canada could amend its own Constitution without the British Parliament

7. 1995 Quebec 第二次獨立公投

  • 結果是留在加拿大 50.6% 對 49.4%，僅差 1.2 個百分點The result was 50.6% to 49.4% to stay — a margin of just 1.2 points

Day 8：政府架構 How Canadians Govern Themselves

對應官方章節：How Canadians Govern Themselves 建議閱讀：PDF p.29–p.32

今日重點

1. 加拿大的政體：3 個關鍵詞（必背）

Canada is a constitutional monarchy, a parliamentary democracy, and a federal state.

  • 君主立憲制：國王是元首，但必須遵守憲法Constitutional monarchy: the King is head of state but is bound by the Constitution
  • 議會民主：人民選出代表組成國會，由國會多數黨組政府Parliamentary democracy: voters elect members of Parliament, and the party with the most seats forms the government
  • 聯邦制：聯邦、省、領地與市政府各有權責Federal state: powers are divided among federal, provincial, territorial and municipal governments

2. 政府的 3 個層級

層級 範圍 例子
Federal 聯邦 全國事務 國防、外交、貨幣、移民、刑法
Provincial 省 / Territorial 領地 各省事務 教育、健保、自然資源、財產法
Municipal 市政 / Local 地方事務 公車、垃圾、警消、地方稅

加拿大有十個省、三個領地，以及數千個市政府。Canada has ten provinces, three territories and thousands of municipalities.

3. 國會 Parliament 的 3 部分（超常考）

The Sovereign, the Senate, and the House of Commons.

a) The Sovereign 君主

  • 現任君主是 King Charles IIIThe Sovereign today is King Charles III
  • 在加拿大由 總督 Governor General 代表He is represented in Canada by the Governor General
  • 現任總督是 Mary Simon，史上首位原住民總督，2021 年上任The Governor General is Mary Simon, the first Aboriginal person to hold the office, appointed in 2021
  • 總督任期大約五年The Governor General usually serves about five years

b) The Senate 參議院

  • 大約 105 位參議員There are about 105 senators
  • 由總理提名、總督任命，不是民選They are appointed by the Governor General on the advice of the Prime Minister, not elected
  • 可任職到 75 歲They may serve until age 75
  • 代表各地區、少數族裔與不同的利益They represent regions, minorities and different interests
  • 常被稱為「冷靜複審之院 Chamber of Sober Second Thought」It is known as the Chamber of Sober Second Thought

c) The House of Commons 眾議院

  • 目前有 338 個席次，席次按人口分配It has 338 seats, distributed by population
  • 由人民直接選出Members are elected directly by the people
  • 任期最長四年A Parliament lasts at most four years
  • 議員稱為 MP，Member of ParliamentA member is called an MP, a Member of Parliament
  • 席次最多的政黨黨魁出任 總理 Prime MinisterThe leader of the party with the most seats becomes Prime Minister

4. 立法流程：一個法案怎麼變法律（必背）

  1. 一讀 First Reading：在眾議院提出法案First reading: the bill is introduced in the House of Commons
  2. 二讀 Second Reading：辯論法案的原則Second reading: the principle of the bill is debated
  3. 委員會審查 Committee Stage：逐條檢視Committee stage: the bill is examined clause by clause
  4. 報告階段 Report Stage：報告修改內容Report stage: the amendments are reported back
  5. 三讀 Third Reading：表決Third reading: the House votes
  6. 送參議院重複同樣程序The Senate repeats the same steps
  7. 御准 Royal Assent：由總督代表君主簽署Royal assent: the Governor General signs on the Sovereign's behalf
  8. 正式成為加拿大的法律The bill becomes the law of Canada

5. 行政分支

  • 總理 Prime Minister 是政府首長，也是多數黨黨魁The Prime Minister is the head of government and leader of the governing party
  • 內閣 Cabinet 由總理任命，成員多半是議員The Cabinet is chosen by the Prime Minister, usually from among MPs
  • 內閣部長 各自負責一個部會Cabinet ministers each run a department
  • 公務員體系 Public Service 負責執行政策The public service carries out the work of government

6. 司法分支

司法部分在 Day 10 詳談。The courts are covered on Day 10.

7. 省級政府架構（並行對照）

聯邦 省
君主 → Governor General 總督 君主 → Lieutenant Governor 省督
Prime Minister 總理 Premier 省長
House of Commons Legislative Assembly（多數省）/ National Assembly（Quebec）
MP（聯邦議員） MLA / MPP（Ontario）/ MNA（Quebec）

8. Ontario 重點（你的省份）

  • 首府是 TorontoThe capital is Toronto
  • 省督 Lieutenant Governor 是 Edith Dumont，2023 年起，是首位出任此職的法裔安省人The Lieutenant Governor is Edith Dumont, since 2023, the first Franco-Ontarian in the post
  • 省長 Premier 是 Doug Ford，進步保守黨，2018 年起，2022 與 2025 連任The Premier is Doug Ford of the Progressive Conservatives, in office since 2018 and re-elected in 2022 and 2025
  • 省議會是 Legislative Assembly of Ontario，議員稱 MPPThe legislature is the Legislative Assembly of Ontario, and members are MPPs
  • 執政黨是安省進步保守黨The governing party is the Progressive Conservative Party of Ontario
  • 官方反對黨黨魁是 Marit Stiles，新民主黨，2023 年起The Leader of the Opposition is Marit Stiles of the NDP, since 2023

臨考前一週請上 ontario.ca 再核對最新的人物變動。

今日驗收題（20 題）

  1. 用一句英文形容加拿大政體，要含三個關鍵詞。Describe Canada's system of government in one English sentence with the three key words.
  2. 加拿大政府有哪三個層級？What are the three levels of government?
  3. 醫療屬於聯邦還是省的管轄？Is health care federal or provincial?
  4. 移民屬於聯邦還是省的管轄？Is immigration federal or provincial?
  5. 加拿大國會的三個部分是什麼？What are the three parts of Parliament?
  6. 加拿大現任君主是誰？Who is Canada's Sovereign today?
  7. 在加拿大，誰代表君主行使日常職權？Who represents the Sovereign in Canada?
  8. 現任總督是誰？她的歷史意義是什麼？Who is the Governor General, and why is her appointment historic?
  9. 參議員如何產生？可以做到幾歲？How are senators chosen, and until what age may they serve?
  10. 眾議院有多少席？任期最長幾年？How many seats are in the House of Commons, and how long is a term?
  11. 眾議員的英文簡稱是什麼？What is the short form for a member of the House of Commons?
  12. 一個法案要經過哪些階段才會變成法律？What stages does a bill go through to become law?
  13. 「Royal Assent」是什麼意思？由誰代為簽署？What is royal assent, and who gives it?
  14. 加拿大總理是怎麼產生的？How does someone become Prime Minister?
  15. 在 Ontario，代表君主的職位叫什麼？What is the Sovereign's representative in Ontario called?
  16. 在 Ontario，省議員的縮寫是什麼？What is the short form for a member of Ontario's legislature?
  17. Ontario 的首府是哪裡？What is the capital of Ontario?
  18. Ontario 現任省長是誰？屬於哪一黨？Who is the Premier of Ontario, and which party?
  19. Ontario 現任省督是誰？她的歷史意義是什麼？Who is Ontario's Lieutenant Governor, and why is it notable?
  20. Quebec 的省議會名稱與其他省有何不同？How is the name of Quebec's legislature different?
答案與解析（點擊展開）
  1. Canada is a constitutional monarchy, a parliamentary democracy, and a federal state.Canada is a constitutional monarchy, a parliamentary democracy, and a federal state.
  2. 聯邦、省與領地、市政。Federal, provincial or territorial, and municipal.
  3. 省。Provincial.
  4. 聯邦。Federal.
  5. 君主、參議院、眾議院。The Sovereign, the Senate and the House of Commons.
  6. King Charles III。King Charles III.
  7. 總督 Governor General。The Governor General.
  8. Mary Simon，史上首位原住民總督，2021 年上任。Mary Simon, the first Aboriginal Governor General, appointed in 2021.
  9. 由總理提名、總督任命；可任職到 75 歲。Appointed by the Governor General on the Prime Minister's advice, serving until age 75.
  10. 338 席，任期最長 四年。338 seats, and a term of at most four years.
  11. MP，Member of Parliament。MP, Member of Parliament.
  12. 一讀、二讀、委員會、報告、三讀，送參議院重複，最後御准。First reading, second reading, committee, report, third reading, the same again in the Senate, then royal assent.
  13. 御准，由 總督 代表君主簽署。Royal assent, given by the Governor General on the Sovereign's behalf.
  14. 由眾議院席次最多的政黨黨魁出任。The leader of the party with the most seats in the House of Commons.
  15. 省督 Lieutenant Governor。The Lieutenant Governor.
  16. MPP，Member of Provincial Parliament。MPP, Member of Provincial Parliament.
  17. Toronto。Toronto.
  18. Doug Ford，進步保守黨 Progressive Conservative。Doug Ford, of the Progressive Conservatives.
  19. Edith Dumont，首位法裔安省人省督，2023 年起。Edith Dumont, the first Franco-Ontarian Lieutenant Governor, since 2023.
  20. Quebec 叫 National Assembly，議員稱 MNA；其他省叫 Legislative Assembly。Quebec's is the National Assembly and its members are MNAs; elsewhere it is the Legislative Assembly.

Day 9：聯邦選舉 + 主要政黨

對應官方章節：Federal Elections 建議閱讀：PDF p.33–p.36

今日重點

1. 投票權

  • 滿 18 歲的加拿大公民 就可以投票Canadian citizens aged 18 or over may vote
  • 投票既是權利也是責任Voting is both a right and a responsibility
  • 選務由獨立機構 Elections Canada 負責Elections are run by the independent agency Elections Canada

2. 聯邦大選的基本規則

  • 一屆國會最長 四年，戰時可例外延長A Parliament lasts at most four years, with an exception in wartime
  • 公民投票選出自己選區的 MPVoters elect the MP for their own riding
  • 全國分為 338 個選區，英文叫 ridings 或 electoral districtsThe country is divided into 338 ridings, also called electoral districts
  • 每區選一位議員，得票最多者當選，稱為簡單多數制Each riding elects one member — the candidate with the most votes wins, which is called first-past-the-post

3. 大選後組政府

  • 選後由 眾議院席次最多的政黨 黨魁，經總督邀請組閣After the election the Governor General invites the leader of the party with the most seats to form a government
  • 多數政府：席次超過半數A majority government holds more than half the seats
  • 少數政府：席次未過半，必須與其他政黨合作A minority government holds fewer, and must work with other parties

4. 主要聯邦政黨（必背 5 大政黨）

簡稱 全名 立場概述
Liberal Liberal Party of Canada 自由黨 中間偏左
Conservative Conservative Party of Canada 保守黨 中間偏右
NDP New Democratic Party 新民主黨 社會民主、勞工為主
Bloc Québécois Bloc Québécois 魁北克集團 僅在 Quebec 競選
Green Green Party of Canada 綠黨 環保優先

5. 反對黨機制

  • 眾議院 第二多席次的政黨 就是 官方反對黨The party with the second most seats becomes the Official Opposition
  • 它的黨魁稱為 Leader of the OppositionIts leader is the Leader of the Opposition
  • 反對黨會組「影子內閣 Shadow Cabinet」對應每個部會The Opposition forms a shadow cabinet to mirror each department
  • 反對黨的核心職責是 讓政府向人民負責Its central job is to hold the government accountable

6. 如何投票

  • 投票前會收到 投票通知卡 Voter Information CardBefore the vote you receive a voter information card
  • 到指定的 投票站 polling station 投票You vote at your assigned polling station
  • 要帶 政府發行的有效身分證件Bring government-issued identification
  • 可以提前投票、郵寄投票，或當天到投票站投You may vote at an advance poll, by mail, or in person on election day

7. 法案如何成為法律（補強 Day 8）

First → Second → Committee → Report → Third → Senate（重複）→ Royal Assent

只有 眾議院 可以提出涉及稅收與支出的 財政法案 money bills。Only the House of Commons may introduce money bills, which deal with taxes and spending.

8. 公民可以怎麼參與政治

  • 加入政黨，或參與黨魁選舉Join a political party, or take part in choosing its leader
  • 競選聯邦議員、省議員、市議員或市長Run for MP, MPP or MLA, city councillor or mayor
  • 寫信給民意代表，或直接聯絡他們的選區辦公室Write to your elected representatives or contact their constituency office
  • 投票、參加公眾諮詢、擔任陪審員Vote, take part in public consultations, and serve on a jury

9. Ontario 與 Toronto 的聯邦選舉小知識

  • Ontario 在眾議院有 121 席，是席次最多的省Ontario holds 121 seats in the House of Commons, more than any other province
  • 在 Toronto 投票時，MP 是聯邦議員、MPP 是省議員、市議員屬於市政層級In Toronto your MP is federal, your MPP is provincial, and your councillor is municipal
  • 考前記得上 elections.ca 查你選區的 MP 姓名Before the test, look up your riding's MP at elections.ca

  1. 加拿大幾歲可以投票？At what age may a Canadian vote?
  2. 選務管理機構叫什麼名字？What is the name of the agency that runs elections?
  3. 全國共有多少個聯邦選區？How many federal ridings are there?
  4. 加拿大採用什麼選舉制度？What electoral system does Canada use?
  5. 多數政府與少數政府差在哪裡？What is the difference between a majority and a minority government?
  6. 大選後由誰邀請新總理組閣？Who invites the new prime minister to form a government?
  7. 加拿大五大聯邦政黨是哪些？寫出四個即可。Name the five main federal parties; four will do.
  8. 哪一個政黨只在 Quebec 競選？Which party runs candidates only in Quebec?
  9. 「Official Opposition」是什麼？由誰擔任黨魁？What is the Official Opposition, and who leads it?
  10. 「Shadow Cabinet」是什麼？What is a shadow cabinet?
  11. 反對黨的核心職責是什麼？What is the Opposition's main job?
  12. 投票通知卡的英文名稱是什麼？What is the voter information card called?
  13. 投票時需要帶什麼？What do you need to bring in order to vote?
  14. 「Advance Polling」是什麼？What is advance polling?
  15. 眾議員任期最多幾年？How long is a term in the House of Commons?
  16. 「Money bills」只能從哪一院提出？In which chamber must money bills start?
  17. 法案完成立法的最後一步是什麼？What is the final step before a bill becomes law?
  18. 公民還能透過哪些方式參與政治？寫出三種。Name three other ways citizens can take part in politics.
  19. Ontario 在聯邦眾議院大約有多少席？About how many House of Commons seats does Ontario have?
  20. 在 Toronto，你的 MP 與 MPP 分別代表哪一級政府？In Toronto, which level of government does your MP represent, and which your MPP?
答案與解析（點擊展開）
  1. 滿 18 歲的加拿大公民。Canadian citizens aged 18 or over.
  2. Elections Canada。Elections Canada.
  3. 338 個選區。338.
  4. 簡單多數制 first-past-the-post，每個選區得票最多的人當選。First-past-the-post — the candidate with the most votes in each riding wins.
  5. 多數政府是執政黨單獨過半；少數政府未過半，要靠其他黨才能通過法案。A majority government holds more than half the seats; a minority does not, and needs other parties to pass bills.
  6. 總督 Governor General。The Governor General.
  7. Liberal、Conservative、NDP、Bloc Québécois、Green。The Liberals, Conservatives, NDP, Bloc Québécois and Greens.
  8. Bloc Québécois。The Bloc Québécois.
  9. 官方反對黨，由眾議院席次第二多的政黨黨魁擔任，職銜是 Leader of the Opposition。The Official Opposition, led by the head of the party with the second most seats, titled Leader of the Opposition.
  10. 影子內閣，反對黨對應每個政府部會指派一位發言人。A shadow cabinet — Opposition critics assigned to match each government department.
  11. 讓政府向人民負責。To hold the government accountable.
  12. Voter Information Card。The voter information card.
  13. 政府發行的有效身分證件，要能證明姓名與地址。Government-issued ID showing your name and address.
  14. 提前投票，在大選日之前開放的投票方式。Voting at a poll open before election day.
  15. 四年，戰時可延至五年。Four years, five in wartime.
  16. 眾議院 House of Commons。The House of Commons.
  17. 御准 Royal Assent，由總督代為簽署。Royal assent, given by the Governor General.
  18. 加入政黨、競選公職、寫信給民代、參與公眾諮詢、擔任陪審員，任三種。Joining a party, running for office, writing to representatives, joining consultations, serving on a jury — any three.
  19. 121 席，是全國最多的省。121 — more than any other province.
  20. MP 代表聯邦，MPP 代表省。Your MP represents you federally; your MPP provincially.

  • [ ] 講得出五大政黨的名稱You can name the five main parties
  • [ ] 解釋得出簡單多數制，以及多數政府與少數政府的差別You can explain first-past-the-post and the majority/minority difference

Day 10：司法系統 The Justice System

對應官方章節：The Justice System 建議閱讀：PDF p.37–p.39

今日重點

1. 法治 Rule of Law（核心觀念）

Government and citizens, including the most powerful, are all bound by the law.

  • 沒有人可以凌駕於法律之上No one is above the law
  • 個人與政府受同一套法律約束Individuals and governments are bound by the same laws
  • 法律必須清楚、公開，而且對所有人一體適用Laws must be clear, public, and applied to everyone alike

2. 法律的核心原則（常考）

  1. 無罪推定：未經定罪之前都是無辜的Presumption of innocence: everyone is innocent until proven guilty
  2. 公正審判：由獨立的法官審理The right to a fair trial before an independent judge
  3. 沉默權：不必自證其罪The right to remain silent — no one must incriminate themselves
  4. 速審權：案件應在合理時間內審理The right to be tried within a reasonable time
  5. 司法獨立：法官不受政府或政黨指揮Judicial independence: judges take no orders from government or parties

3. 警察 Police

加拿大有三層警力：Canada has three levels of policing:

警力 範圍
Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) 皇家騎警 聯邦警察，也在多數省份擔任省警；加拿大象徵之一
Provincial Police 省警 只有 Ontario（OPP）、Quebec（SQ）、Newfoundland 自有省警
Municipal Police 市警 大城市自有警隊，例如 Toronto Police Service

被警察攔下時要保持冷靜、配合，但你有保持沉默與聯絡律師的權利。If the police stop you, stay calm and co-operate — but you have the right to remain silent and to speak to a lawyer.

4. 法院系統 The Courts

層級 名稱 職能
最高 Supreme Court of Canada 9 名法官；最終上訴；解釋憲法
上訴 Court of Appeal（各省一個 ＋ 聯邦） 審理上訴
高等 Superior Court（各省名稱不同） 重大刑事與民事
初級 Provincial / Territorial Court 小型刑事、家庭、青少年
  • 最高法院有 九位法官，由 首席法官 Chief Justice 領導The Supreme Court has nine judges, led by the Chief Justice
  • 法官由 聯邦政府任命Judges are appointed by the federal government

5. 陪審團 Jury

  • 重大刑案由 十二人陪審團 評議Serious criminal cases are decided by a jury of twelve
  • 服務陪審團是公民的責任，被抽到不能無故拒絕Jury service is a responsibility of citizenship, and you may not refuse without good reason

6. Habeas Corpus

拉丁文意思是「你應提交此人」——被拘留的人可以要求出庭，挑戰拘留是否合法。The Latin means "you must produce the body" — a detained person may go before a court and challenge the detention.

7. Charter 與司法的關係

  • 有了 1982 年憲章，法院可以審查 政府的行為是否違憲Since the 1982 Charter the courts may review whether government action is constitutional
  • 違憲的法律，法院可以宣告無效A law that breaches the Charter can be struck down

8. 加拿大特殊原則

  • 司法獨立：法官受憲法保障，不能被輕易免職Judicial independence: judges are protected by the Constitution and cannot easily be removed
  • 法律之前人人平等：不分種族、性別、宗教、語言或年齡Equality before the law, regardless of race, sex, religion, language or age

  3. 「Presumption of innocence」是什麼意思？What does presumption of innocence mean?
  4. 加拿大警察有哪三層？What are the three levels of policing?
  5. RCMP 的全名是什麼？What does RCMP stand for?
  6. 哪三個省有自己的省警？Which three provinces have their own provincial police?
  7. 加拿大最高法院叫什麼？有幾位法官？What is Canada's highest court called, and how many judges sit on it?
  8. 法官由誰任命？Who appoints judges?
  9. 重大刑案的陪審團由幾人組成？How many people sit on a jury in a serious criminal case?
  10. 服務陪審團是責任還是權利？Is jury service a responsibility or a right?
  11. Habeas Corpus 是什麼？What is habeas corpus?
  12. 1982 年憲章對司法有什麼意義？What did the 1982 Charter mean for the courts?
  13. 加拿大法官能被隨意免職嗎？這叫什麼原則？Can judges be removed at will, and what is that principle called?
  14. 「Equality before the law」是憲章保障的嗎？Is equality before the law protected by the Charter?
  15. 「Right to remain silent」是什麼？What is the right to remain silent?
  16. Toronto 的市警隊叫什麼？What is Toronto's municipal police force called?
  17. Ontario 的省警縮寫是什麼？What is the short form for Ontario's provincial police?
  18. Quebec 的省警叫什麼？What is Quebec's provincial police called?
  19. 被警察攔下時，最重要的權利是什麼？If the police stop you, what are your most important rights?
  20. 法院若發現一條法律違反憲章，可以怎麼做？What can a court do if a law breaches the Charter?
答案與解析（點擊展開）
  1. 政府與人民，包括最有權力的人，全都受法律約束，沒有人凌駕於法律之上。Governments and citizens, including the most powerful, are all bound by the law; no one is above it.
  2. 無罪推定、公正審判、沉默權、速審權、司法獨立，任三項。Presumption of innocence, a fair trial, the right to silence, a timely trial, and judicial independence — any three.
  3. 未經證明有罪之前，任何人都是無辜的。Everyone is innocent until proven guilty.
  4. 聯邦的 RCMP、省警、市警。The RCMP federally, provincial police, and municipal police.
  5. Royal Canadian Mounted Police 皇家騎警。The Royal Canadian Mounted Police.
  6. Ontario、Quebec、Newfoundland and Labrador。Ontario, Quebec, and Newfoundland and Labrador.
  7. Supreme Court of Canada，共 九位法官。The Supreme Court of Canada, with nine judges.
  8. 聯邦政府。The federal government.
  9. 十二人。Twelve.
  10. 責任。A responsibility.
  11. 被拘留的人可以要求出庭，挑戰拘留是否合法。The right of a detained person to challenge the detention before a court.
  12. 它讓法院可以 審查政府的行為是否違憲。It lets the courts review whether government action is constitutional.
  13. 不能；這是 司法獨立 原則。No — that is judicial independence.
  14. 是，憲章第 15 條明文保障。Yes, in section 15 of the Charter.
  15. 沉默權，你不必自證其罪。The right not to incriminate yourself.
  16. Toronto Police Service。The Toronto Police Service.
  17. OPP，Ontario Provincial Police。OPP, the Ontario Provincial Police.
  18. Sûreté du Québec，簡稱 SQ。The Sûreté du Québec, or SQ.
  19. 保持沉默，以及聯絡律師。To remain silent, and to speak to a lawyer.
  20. 宣告該法律違憲的部分無效。Strike down the part of the law that breaches the Charter.

  • [ ] 記得最高法院九位法官，以及 Ontario 的法院與警察You remember the nine Supreme Court judges and Ontario's courts and police

Day 11：加拿大象徵 + 國歌 + 國定假日 + 榮譽

對應官方章節：Canadian Symbols、Anthems、Important Dates 建議閱讀：PDF p.40–p.45

今日重點

1. 國旗 The National Flag

  • 紅白楓葉旗 Maple Leaf flagThe red and white maple leaf flag
  • 1965 年 2 月 15 日首次升起First raised on February 15, 1965
  • 2 月 15 日是 National Flag of Canada Day 國旗日February 15 is National Flag of Canada Day

2. 主要國家象徵（必背）

符號 中文 / 意義
The Maple Leaf 楓葉 從 1700 年代起象徵加拿大
The Beaver 河狸 1975 列為加拿大象徵，源於毛皮貿易
The Crown 皇冠 君主制象徵；出現在郵箱、警徽
The Coat of Arms 國徽 含獅、獨角獸、楓葉，箴言 A Mari Usque Ad Mare
The Maple Tree 楓樹 加拿大原生樹種
Fleur-de-lys 鳶尾花 法裔加拿大的象徵
Hockey 冰球 加拿大冬季國民運動
Lacrosse 長曲棍球 加拿大夏季國民運動

加拿大有兩項官方國民運動：冬季是冰球，夏季是長曲棍球。Canada has two official national sports: hockey in winter and lacrosse in summer.

3. 國徽箴言

  • 箴言是 A Mari Usque Ad MareThe motto is A Mari Usque Ad Mare
  • 拉丁文，意思是 從海到海It is Latin for "from sea to sea"
  • 出自聖經詩篇 72 篇 8 節It comes from Psalm 72:8

4. 國歌 O Canada（必背前四句）

O Canada! Our home and native land! True patriot love in all of us command. With glowing hearts we see thee rise, The True North strong and free!

  • 1880 年由 Calixa Lavallée 作曲，原本是法文歌Composed by Calixa Lavallée in 1880, originally in French
  • 1980 年正式成為加拿大國歌It became the official national anthem in 1980
  • 皇室國歌是 God Save the KingThe royal anthem is God Save the King

5. 主要國定假日

月份 假日
1 月 1 日 New Year’s Day 元旦
春季 Good Friday 受難日
春季 Easter Monday 復活節週一
5 月 25 日前的週一 Victoria Day 維多利亞日
7 月 1 日 Canada Day 加拿大國慶
9 月第一個週一 Labour Day 勞動節
9 月 30 日 National Day for Truth and Reconciliation 真相與和解日
10 月第二個週一 Thanksgiving 感恩節
11 月 11 日 Remembrance Day 國殤紀念日
12 月 25 日 Christmas Day 聖誕節
12 月 26 日 Boxing Day 節禮日

6. 國殤紀念日 Remembrance Day

  • 11 月 11 日上午 11 時默哀兩分鐘Canadians observe two minutes of silence at 11 a.m. on November 11
  • 紀念第一次世界大戰 1918 年 11 月 11 日停戰It marks the armistice that ended the First World War on that date in 1918
  • 紅罌粟花的典故來自 John McCrae 的詩《In Flanders Fields》The poppy comes from John McCrae's poem "In Flanders Fields"

7. 加拿大勳銜系統

  • 最高的平民榮譽是 Order of Canada 加拿大勳章，1967 年建國百年時創立The highest civilian honour is the Order of Canada, created in 1967
  • 軍事最高榮譽是 Victoria CrossThe highest military honour is the Victoria Cross
  • Cross of Valour 表彰極度的勇氣The Cross of Valour recognizes acts of the most conspicuous courage
  • Star of Military Valour 表彰戰場上的英勇The Star of Military Valour recognizes gallantry in the face of the enemy

8. 重要日子

  • 2 月 15 日是國旗日February 15 is Flag Day
  • 4 月 9 日是維米嶺日April 9 is Vimy Ridge Day
  • 7 月 1 日是加拿大日July 1 is Canada Day
  • 9 月 30 日是真相與和解日，大家穿橘色 T 恤September 30 is Truth and Reconciliation Day, when people wear orange shirts
  • 11 月 11 日是國殤紀念日November 11 is Remembrance Day

9. 加拿大貨幣

  • Loonie 是一元硬幣，上面是潛鳥 loonThe loonie is the one-dollar coin, with a loon on it
  • Toonie 是兩元硬幣The toonie is the two-dollar coin
  • 五元鈔票上是 Sir Wilfrid LaurierThe five-dollar bill shows Sir Wilfrid Laurier
  • 十元鈔票上是 Viola Desmond，黑人民權英雄，2018 年取代 MacdonaldThe ten shows Viola Desmond, a civil-rights hero who replaced Macdonald in 2018
  • 二十元鈔票上是 Queen Elizabeth II，日後將換成 King Charles IIIThe twenty shows Queen Elizabeth II, and will carry King Charles III in future
  • 五十元鈔票上是前總理 William Lyon Mackenzie KingThe fifty shows former prime minister William Lyon Mackenzie King
  • 一百元鈔票上是前總理 Sir Robert BordenThe hundred shows former prime minister Sir Robert Borden

答案與解析（點擊展開）
  1. 1965 年。1965.

  4. 冰球 Hockey（冬）與長曲棍球 Lacrosse（夏）。Hockey in winter and lacrosse in summer.
  5. A Mari Usque Ad Mare，意思是 從海到海。A Mari Usque Ad Mare — "from sea to sea".
  6. Calixa Lavallée，1880 年。Calixa Lavallée, in 1880.
  7. 1980 年。1980.
  8. God Save the King。God Save the King.
  9. 7 月 1 日。July 1.
  10. 11 月 11 日。November 11.
  11. 紅罌粟花；出自 John McCrae 的《In Flanders Fields》。The poppy, from John McCrae's "In Flanders Fields".

  17. Viola Desmond，黑人民權英雄，2018 年取代 Macdonald。Viola Desmond, a Black civil-rights hero, who replaced Macdonald in 2018.
  18. Sir Wilfrid Laurier。Sir Wilfrid Laurier.
  19. 一元；上面是 潛鳥 loon。One dollar, with a loon on it.
  20. 兩元。Two dollars.

Day 12：加拿大經濟 Canada’s Economy

對應官方章節：Canada’s Economy 建議閱讀：PDF p.46–p.48

今日重點

1. 加拿大是「貿易大國 Trading Nation」

  • 貿易佔 GDP 六成以上Trade accounts for more than 60% of GDP
  • 加拿大是 G7 與 G20 的成員Canada belongs to both the G7 and the G20
  • 加拿大是 世界上最富裕的國家之一Canada is one of the wealthiest countries in the world

2. 三大產業類別（常考）

類別 英文 範例
服務業 Service Industries 交通、教育、健保、銀行、IT、政府服務
製造業 Manufacturing Industries 汽車、紙、食品、技術產品
自然資源業 Natural Resources Industries 林業、漁業、農業、能源、礦業
  • 服務業雇用約七成五的勞動力Service industries employ about 75% of workers
  • 製造業雇用約兩成Manufacturing employs about 20%
  • 自然資源雇用約半成，但出口貢獻很大Natural resources employ about 5%, but account for a large share of exports

3. 重要產業

  • 石油與天然氣主要在 Alberta、Saskatchewan 與紐芬蘭外海Oil and gas come mainly from Alberta, Saskatchewan and offshore Newfoundland
  • 礦業產出黃金、鎳與鉀肥Mining produces gold, nickel and potash
  • 林業集中在 BC、Quebec 與 OntarioForestry is centred in BC, Quebec and Ontario
  • 漁業分布在大西洋與太平洋兩岸Fishing takes place on both the Atlantic and Pacific coasts
  • 農業以草原省的小麥與芥花為主Agriculture is dominated by Prairie wheat and canola
  • 製造業集中在 Ontario 與 Quebec，包括汽車與飛機Manufacturing is concentrated in Ontario and Quebec, including cars and aircraft
  • 金融業以 Toronto 為中心，那裡有多倫多證交所 TSXFinance is centred in Toronto, home of the Toronto Stock Exchange

4. 最大貿易夥伴

  • 美國是加拿大最大的貿易夥伴，雙邊貿易每年超過八千億加幣The United States is Canada's largest trading partner, with more than 800 billion dollars of trade a year
  • 其次是中國、英國、日本與墨西哥Next come China, the United Kingdom, Japan and Mexico

5. 自由貿易協定（重要年份）

年份 協定
1989 加美自由貿易協定 CUSFTA
1994 NAFTA（加、美、墨）
2020 USMCA / CUSMA（取代 NAFTA）
2017 CETA 加歐自由貿易協定
2018 CPTPP 跨太平洋夥伴協定

6. 加拿大的國際地位

  • G7，七大工業國組織The G7, the group of seven industrialized democracies
  • G20，二十國集團The G20
  • OECD，經濟合作暨發展組織The OECD
  • APEC，亞太經濟合作APEC, Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation
  • NATO，北大西洋公約組織NATO
  • 聯合國 UNThe United Nations
  • Commonwealth，大英國協The Commonwealth
  • La Francophonie，法語國家組織La Francophonie

7. 工會與勞工保護

  • 工會在加拿大是合法的Labour unions are legal in Canada
  • 勞工在依法協商破裂後有罷工權Workers have the right to strike once lawful bargaining has failed
  • 最低工資與工作安全由省層級規範Minimum wages and safety standards are set by the provinces

8. 重要加拿大企業

  • Bombardier 製造飛機與火車Bombardier makes aircraft and trains
  • Magna International 生產汽車零件Magna International makes auto parts
  • CGI 是資訊科技公司CGI is an information-technology company
  • 五大銀行是 RBC、TD、Scotiabank、BMO、CIBCThe five big banks are RBC, TD, Scotiabank, BMO and CIBC
  • Loblaws 是最大的雜貨連鎖Loblaws is the largest grocery chain

9. Ontario 經濟重點

  • Ontario 是全國經濟規模最大的省Ontario has the largest economy of any province
  • Windsor 到 Toronto 的走廊是汽車製造中心The Windsor-to-Toronto corridor is the heart of the auto industry
  • Toronto 的 Bay Street 是加拿大的金融中心Toronto's Bay Street is Canada's financial centre
  • Toronto 到 Waterloo 之間是科技走廊The Toronto-Waterloo corridor is Canada's technology belt

今日驗收題（20 題）

  1. 加拿大是 G7 還是 G20 的成員？Is Canada in the G7, the G20, or both?
  2. 加拿大三大產業類別是什麼？What are the three main types of industry?
  3. 哪一類產業雇用最多勞動力？比例大約多少？Which employs the most workers, and what share?
  4. 加拿大最大的貿易夥伴是哪一國？Who is Canada's largest trading partner?
  5. 1989 年簽訂的加美貿易協定縮寫是什麼？What is the short name of the 1989 Canada-US trade deal?
  6. 2020 年取代 NAFTA 的協定簡稱是什麼？What replaced NAFTA in 2020?
  7. CETA 是哪兩方的貿易協定？Between whom is CETA?
  8. CPTPP 的全名是什麼？What does CPTPP stand for?
  9. 加拿大屬於 G7 代表什麼意義？What does G7 membership say about Canada?
  10. 加拿大屬於哪些主要國際組織？寫出四個。Name four international organizations Canada belongs to.
  11. 加拿大石油主要產在哪些省？Where is most of Canada's oil produced?
  12. 草原省主要生產什麼農產品？What do the Prairie provinces mainly grow?
  13. 加拿大證交所的縮寫是什麼？在哪個城市？What is Canada's stock exchange called, and where is it?
  14. 加拿大重要的飛機與火車製造公司是哪一家？Which Canadian company makes aircraft and trains?
  15. Toronto 的 Bay Street 被稱為加拿大的什麼？What is Bay Street known as?
  16. 加拿大工人有沒有罷工權？Do Canadian workers have the right to strike?
  17. 最低工資由哪一層政府規範？Which level of government sets the minimum wage?
  18. La Francophonie 是什麼組織？加拿大為什麼加入？What is La Francophonie, and why is Canada a member?
  19. Magna International 屬於哪一個產業？What industry is Magna International in?
  20. 加拿大五大銀行任寫兩家。Name two of Canada's five big banks.
答案與解析（點擊展開）
  1. 兩者都是。Both.
  2. 服務業、製造業、自然資源業。Service industries, manufacturing industries and natural resources industries.
  3. 服務業，約 75%。Service industries, about 75%.
  4. 美國。The United States.
  5. CUSFTA，Canada-US Free Trade Agreement。CUSFTA, the Canada-United States Free Trade Agreement.
  6. USMCA，加拿大稱 CUSMA。USMCA, known in Canada as CUSMA.
  7. 加拿大與歐盟。Canada and the European Union.
  8. Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership，共十一國。The Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership, with eleven member countries.
  9. 代表加拿大是 世界主要工業化民主國家之一。It means Canada is one of the world's leading industrialized democracies.
  10. UN、NATO、G7、G20、OECD、APEC、Commonwealth、La Francophonie，任四個。The UN, NATO, the G7, the G20, the OECD, APEC, the Commonwealth and La Francophonie — any four.
  11. Alberta、Saskatchewan、Newfoundland and Labrador。Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Newfoundland and Labrador.
  12. 主要是 小麥與芥花。Mainly wheat and canola.
  13. TSX，Toronto Stock Exchange，在 Toronto。The TSX, the Toronto Stock Exchange, in Toronto.
  14. Bombardier。Bombardier.
  15. 加拿大的 金融中心，相當於華爾街。Canada's financial centre, its Wall Street.
  16. 有，在依法協商破裂之後。Yes, once lawful bargaining has failed.
  17. 省政府。The provinces.
  18. 法語國家組織；加拿大有大量法裔人口，特別是 Quebec 與 New Brunswick。The organization of French-speaking countries; Canada has a large francophone population, especially in Quebec and New Brunswick.
  19. 製造業，生產汽車零件。Manufacturing — auto parts.
  20. RBC、TD、Scotiabank、BMO、CIBC 任兩家。RBC, TD, Scotiabank, BMO or CIBC — any two.

  • [ ] 記得三大產業類別與雇用比例You remember the three types of industry and their share of jobs
  • [ ] 記得 1989 與 2020 兩個年份，以及 CUSMAYou remember 1989, 2020 and CUSMA
  • [ ] 說得出四個以上加拿大所屬的國際組織You can name four or more organizations Canada belongs to

Day 13：加拿大五大地理區、10 省 3 領地（Ontario 加強）

對應官方章節：Canada’s Regions 建議閱讀：PDF p.49–p.60

今日重點

1. 加拿大基本地理

  • 加拿大是世界第二大國家，僅次於俄羅斯Canada is the second-largest country in the world, after Russia
  • 三大洋環繞：東邊大西洋、北邊北冰洋、西邊太平洋Three oceans border it: the Atlantic to the east, the Arctic to the north, the Pacific to the west
  • 與美國共享世界最長的陸地邊界It shares the longest land border in the world with the United States
  • 加拿大首都是 Ottawa，位於 Ontario 省The capital of Canada is Ottawa, in the province of Ontario

2. 五大地理區（必背）

區域 英文 包含的省 / 領地
大西洋區 Atlantic Provinces Newfoundland and Labrador、PEI、Nova Scotia、New Brunswick
中央區 Central Canada Quebec、Ontario
草原區 Prairie Provinces Manitoba、Saskatchewan、Alberta
西海岸 West Coast British Columbia
北方領地 Northern Territories Yukon、Northwest Territories、Nunavut

3. 10 個省 + 首府（必背）

省 首府 加入年份
Newfoundland and Labrador St. John’s 1949
Prince Edward Island (PEI) Charlottetown 1873
Nova Scotia Halifax 1867
New Brunswick Fredericton 1867
Quebec Quebec City 1867
Ontario Toronto 1867
Manitoba Winnipeg 1870
Saskatchewan Regina 1905
Alberta Edmonton 1905
British Columbia (BC) Victoria 1871

領地 首府 加入年份

5. 各省與領地的小知識

  • Quebec 法裔最多；蒙特婁是世界第二大法語城市，僅次於巴黎Quebec has the most francophones; Montreal is the second-largest French-speaking city after Paris
  • Ontario 人口最多、經濟最大；尼加拉瀑布在此Ontario has the largest population and economy; Niagara Falls is here
  • PEI 是最小的省，《清秀佳人》的故鄉，靠聯邦大橋連上本土PEI is the smallest province, home of Anne of Green Gables, linked by the Confederation Bridge
  • Nova Scotia 的 Halifax 是大西洋區最大港，1917 年曾發生大爆炸Nova Scotia's Halifax is the region's biggest port, site of the 1917 explosion
  • New Brunswick 是唯一的官方雙語省New Brunswick is the only officially bilingual province
  • Manitoba 是 Métis 文化中心；Winnipeg 有「西部門戶」之稱Manitoba is the heart of Métis culture; Winnipeg is the Gateway to the West
  • Saskatchewan 是小麥之省；Regina 有皇家騎警的訓練學院Saskatchewan is the wheat province; Regina has the RCMP training academy
  • Alberta 是石油重鎮，境內有洛磯山脈的 Banff 與 Jasper 國家公園Alberta is oil country, with Banff and Jasper national parks in the Rockies
  • BC 是太平洋門戶；Vancouver 主辦 2010 年冬季奧運BC is the Pacific gateway; Vancouver hosted the 2010 Winter Olympics
  • Yukon 有 1896 年的克朗代克淘金潮，以及加拿大最高峰 Mount LoganYukon had the Klondike Gold Rush of 1896 and Canada's highest mountain, Mount Logan
  • NWT 以天然氣、礦業和極光聞名The Northwest Territories are known for gas, mining and the northern lights
  • Nunavut 以因紐特人為主，面積最大而人口最少Nunavut is mostly Inuit, the largest territory with the smallest population

7. 加拿大其他常考地理

  • 最高峰是 Yukon 的 Mount LoganThe highest mountain is Mount Logan in Yukon
  • 最大島是 Nunavut 的 Baffin IslandThe largest island is Baffin Island in Nunavut
  • 加拿大盾 Canadian Shield 是覆蓋大半國土的古老岩盤The Canadian Shield is the ancient rock that covers much of the country
  • 五大湖中有四個與美國共享，只有 Lake Michigan 完全在美國境內Four of the Great Lakes are shared with the United States; only Lake Michigan lies entirely in the U.S.

Part A — 全國地理（10 題）

答案與解析（點擊展開）
  1. 世界第二大，僅次於俄羅斯。The second largest, after Russia.
  2. Ottawa，位於 Ontario。Ottawa, in Ontario.
  3. 大西洋、北冰洋、太平洋。The Atlantic, the Arctic and the Pacific.
  4. 大西洋區、中央區、草原區、西海岸、北方領地。The Atlantic Provinces, Central Canada, the Prairies, the West Coast and the North.
  5. Newfoundland and Labrador、PEI、Nova Scotia、New Brunswick。Newfoundland and Labrador, Prince Edward Island, Nova Scotia and New Brunswick.
  6. Quebec 與 Ontario。Quebec and Ontario.
  7. Manitoba、Saskatchewan、Alberta。Manitoba, Saskatchewan and Alberta.
  8. British Columbia。British Columbia.
  9. Yukon、Northwest Territories、Nunavut。Yukon, the Northwest Territories and Nunavut.
  10. Mount Logan，在 Yukon。Mount Logan, in Yukon.
  11. St. John&#x27;s。St. John's.
  12. Halifax。Halifax.
  13. Fredericton；它是唯一的官方雙語省。Fredericton; it is the only officially bilingual province.
  14. Quebec City。Quebec City.
  15. Winnipeg。Winnipeg.
  16. Regina；皇家騎警 RCMP 的訓練學院在這裡。Regina; the RCMP training academy is there.
  17. Edmonton；Banff 與 Jasper 國家公園。Edmonton; Banff and Jasper.
  18. Victoria；冬奧在 Vancouver 舉辦。Victoria; the Olympics were in Vancouver.
  19. Whitehorse。Whitehorse.
  20. 1999 年；首府是 Iqaluit。1999; the capital is Iqaluit.
  21. Doug Ford，安省進步保守黨。Doug Ford, of the Progressive Conservative Party of Ontario.
  22. Edith Dumont；她是首位出任省督的法裔安省人，2023 年起。Edith Dumont; she is the first Franco-Ontarian Lieutenant Governor, since 2023.
  23. MPP，Member of Provincial Parliament。MPP, Member of Provincial Parliament.
  24. Ontario 首府是 Toronto，加拿大首都是 Ottawa，兩者都在 Ontario 境內。Ontario's capital is Toronto; Canada's is Ottawa — both in Ontario.
  25. 尼加拉瀑布 Niagara Falls，位於 Lake Erie 與 Lake Ontario 之間。Niagara Falls, between Lake Erie and Lake Ontario.

⚠️ 考試規則（兩段）

Part A — 公民、權利、原住民、語言（8 題）

  1. 加拿大兩個官方國民運動是什麼？What are the two national sports?

加拿大公民考試 — 220+ 題庫（依章節）

用法：考試前 1 週每天隨機挑 30 題複習。題目刻意比 Discover Canada 主流題庫稍難一點，過了這份就過得了真實考試。 答案在每章節結尾。

📜 加拿大歷史時間軸 Canada's History Timeline

1497 → 2021 共 41 件考試重點事件。按時代色標分區，⭐ = 高頻考點。點時代按鈕篩選。

1497

John Cabot 抵達加拿大東岸

John Cabot reaches Atlantic shores

為英王宣稱大西洋岸土地，第一個繪製加拿大東岸地圖的人Claimed the Atlantic coast for the English king and was the first to map Canada's East Coast

  • 義大利航海家受英王委派An Italian navigator sailing for the English king
  • 登陸地點可能是 NewfoundlandProbably landed in Newfoundland
  • 為日後英國對加宣稱主權奠基Laid the basis for later British claims
1534

Cartier names 'Canada'

  • 為法王 François I 宣稱聖羅倫斯地區Claimed the St. Lawrence region for King Francis I of France
  • 'Canada' 名字源自 Iroquois 語 'kanata'（村莊）The name Canada comes from kanata, "village"
  • 1550 年代起 Canada 出現在地圖上By the 1550s the name appeared on maps

📖 04 加拿大歷史：故事聽學

從原住民時代到現代加拿大，用 12 個場景記住考試最愛考的關鍵時刻——用中文故事講一遍，關鍵英文詞放慢重複兩次。開車、走路、躺著都能聽，聽完再翻記憶卡、玩小測驗。

尚未開始
🏕️

原住民：加拿大最早的主人

在歐洲人出現的好幾千年前，加拿大這片土地上已經住著許多原住民族——他們有自己的政府、自己的語言，還有自己的貿易網絡。 可惜歐洲人後來帶來的疾病，讓原住民人口一下子少了將近一半到八成，非常慘烈。

⛵

第一批歐洲人：維京人、卡伯特、卡蒂亞

大概西元一千年，一群從冰島來的維京人，先到了格陵蘭，接著一路划到了紐芬蘭島，成為第一批踏上北美的歐洲人。 1497 年，一位替英國國王工作的義大利探險家登陸紐芬蘭，宣告這塊地是英國的，他的名字是—— John Cabot. John Cabot. 接下來換法國人出手了。1534 到 1542 年之間， Jacques Cartier. 三次橫渡大西洋，替法國宣告主權。他還從原住民嚮導口中聽到一個詞，叫「卡那塔」，意思是「村莊」——這就是「加拿大」這個名字的由來！

🏰

新法蘭西誕生：魁北克城的誕生

1608 年，法國探險家 Samuel de Champlain. 在今天的魁北克市蓋了一座堡壘，他被稱為「新法蘭西之父」。從此，法國人跟原住民一起靠著毛皮貿易，把生意做到哈德遜灣到墨西哥灣那麼大！

⚔️

英法大對決：亞伯拉罕平原之役

英國跟法國為了爭奪北美，打了一百多年的仗。決定勝負的關鍵一戰，發生在 1759 年的魁北克市，叫做—— Battle of the Plains of Abraham. Battle of the Plains of Abraham. 這一戰非常戲劇化：英軍將領沃夫，跟法軍將領蒙特卡姆，兩個人都在戰場上陣亡了！最後英國贏了，法國在北美的帝國，就這樣結束了。

🚣

忠貞派大遷徙：四萬人逃亡潮

1776 年，美國獨立革命爆發。大約四萬個效忠英國的人，不想留在剛獨立的美國，就往北逃到了加拿大，他們被稱為—— United Empire Loyalists. 這批新移民裡面還包括了自由黑人，跟一位莫霍克族的領袖約瑟夫．布蘭特。英國後來把魁北克分成了「上加拿大」跟「下加拿大」，也就是今天的安大略跟魁北克。

⛓️

廢除奴隸制的先鋒

1793 年，上加拿大的副總督 John Graves Simcoe. 推動立法，讓上加拿大成為整個大英帝國第一個禁止奴隸制的地方！後來還有三萬名美國黑奴，經過一條叫「地下鐵路」的秘密逃亡路線，來到加拿大尋求自由。

🎖️

1812 年戰爭：保家衛國

1812 年，美國出兵想要併吞加拿大。這時候站出來三位英雄：英軍司令布洛克，原住民首領特庫姆塞，還有一位傳奇女性—— Laura Secord. 她走了三十公里的路去通報美軍的作戰計畫，被視為加拿大的民族英雄。最後加拿大打贏了，沒有被美國併吞——這是加拿大能獨立存在到今天的關鍵一戰！

🎂

建國的那一天：1867 年 7 月 1 日

終於，來到整堂課最重要的一天！安大略、魁北克、新斯科細亞、新布藍瑞克這四個殖民地，決定聯合組成一個國家，這一天就叫—— Confederation. Confederation. 這就是加拿大的生日，後來變成了「加拿大日」。第一任總理，是—— Sir John Alexander Macdonald. 他的頭像，現在就印在十塊錢加幣的鈔票上。

🚂

版圖擴張：橫貫鐵路的血與淚

建國之後，加拿大的版圖越變越大。把東西兩岸串起來的關鍵建設，是 1885 年完工的—— Canadian Pacific Railway. 這條鐵路是由一萬五千名華人工人辛苦建造的，很多人因為工作環境太惡劣而喪命。完工那年，加拿大政府居然還對華人徵收「人頭稅」，一直到 2006 年，當時的總理哈珀才正式道歉並補償。

🗳️

女性投票權：從曼尼托巴到最高法院

1916 年，滿尼托巴省成為加拿大第一個讓女性投票的省份。到了 1929 年，五位女性運動者打贏了一場官司，叫做—— Persons Case. 她們證明了女性在法律上也算是「人」，從此才有資格進入加拿大的參議院。這五位女性，被稱為「Famous Five」。

🎖️

兩次世界大戰：加拿大打出了名號

第一次世界大戰，加拿大軍隊在法國打了一場關鍵戰役，叫做—— Battle of Vimy Ridge. 這一戰被認為是加拿大從英國殖民地，走向獨立國家認同的轉捩點。到了第二次世界大戰，加拿大軍隊參加了 1944 年 6 月 6 日的諾曼第登陸，那個海灘的代號叫—— Juno Beach.

🍁

現代加拿大：憲法回家了

1965 年，現在這面紅白相間的楓葉旗正式誕生。到了 1982 年，時任總理老杜魯道推動了加拿大現代史上最重要的大事——把原本放在英國的加拿大憲法，正式「接回」加拿大，同時加入了保障所有人基本權利的—— Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms. 從這一刻起，加拿大才真正完全掌握了自己的命運。這，就是加拿大歷史，從原住民時代一路走到今天的故事。

🎮 小測驗（6 題，答錯也沒關係，看解說就好）

1. 加拿大的「生日」Confederation 是哪一天？
💡 1867/7/1，四個原始省份（安大略、魁北克、新斯科細亞、新布藍瑞克）組成加拿大自治領。
2. 加拿大第一任總理是誰？
💡 Sir John Alexander Macdonald，頭像印在 $10 加幣鈔票上。
3. 1759 年英法決戰的地點叫什麼？
💡 地點在魁北克市，英軍 Wolfe 對法軍 Montcalm，兩位將軍都戰死。
4. 1929 年 Persons Case 打贏官司的是哪一群人？
💡 五位女性運動者證明女性在法律上算「person」，可以進入參議院。
5. 加拿大憲法「回家」（patriated）是哪一年？
💡 1982 年，PM Pierre Trudeau 推動 Constitution Act，同時通過 Charter of Rights and Freedoms。
6. 1885 年橫貫鐵路（CPR）完工，主要由誰辛苦建造？
💡 15,000 名華工參與建造，後來還被徵收人頭稅，2006 年 Harper 總理道歉補償。

🏛️ 加拿大政府架構 How Canadians Govern Themselves

三張流程圖：三級政府職責、國會三部分、法案如何變法律。

圖 1：三級政府 Three Levels of Government

聯邦 Federal國防、外交、貨幣、刑法、公民身分；總理 Mark CarneyDefence, foreign policy, currency, criminal law, citizenship; PM Mark Carney
省 Provincial教育、醫療、自然資源、公路；Ontario 省長 Doug FordEducation, health, natural resources, highways; Ontario Premier Doug Ford
市鎮 Municipal除雪、消防、大眾運輸、地方法規；Toronto 市長 Olivia ChowSnow removal, firefighting, transit, by-laws; Toronto Mayor Olivia Chow

圖 2：國會三部分 The Three Parts of Parliament

圖 3：法案如何變法律 How a Bill Becomes Law (7 steps)

1
一讀 First Reading
法案視為第一次宣讀並印製The bill is read for the first time and printed
2
二讀 Second Reading
辯論法案原則Members debate the bill's principle
3
委員會 Committee Stage
逐條審議Studied clause by clause
4
報告 Report Stage
提出修正Members can make amendments
5
三讀 Third Reading
辯論並表決Members debate and vote
6
參議院 Senate
同樣的程序A similar process in the Senate
7
御准 Royal Assent
總督代君主簽署 → 成為法律The Governor General grants royal assent → law

⭐ 考試重點：3 讀＋委員會＋送參議院＋御准。法案在每院都要 3 讀。

⚖️ 加拿大司法系統 The Justice System

5 大法律原則 + 4 級法院階層 + RCMP 角色。

5 大法律原則 Five Principles of Canadian Law

法治

Rule of Law

沒人凌駕於法律之上，包括政府、法官、警察No one is above the law, including governments, judges and the police

無罪推定

Presumption of Innocence

被證明有罪前人人無辜Everyone is innocent until proven guilty

正當程序

Due Process

政府必須尊重每個人依法享有的所有權利The government must respect all the legal rights a person is entitled to

人身保護令

Habeas Corpus

挑戰國家非法拘留的權利，來自英國普通法The right to challenge unlawful detention, from English common law

法律之下的自由

Freedom under the Law

法律提供秩序與和平解決糾紛的方式Laws provide order and a peaceful way to settle disputes

4 級法院階層 The Courts

⭐ 考試重點：四級法院、Supreme Court 9 位法官、最高法院判決最終。

皇家騎警 RCMP（Royal Canadian Mounted Police）

🐎 加拿大國家警察

  • 聯邦警察Federal police在全加拿大執行聯邦法律Enforces federal laws throughout Canada
  • 省警察Provincial police在 Ontario、Quebec 以外的省與地區擔任省警Serves as provincial police everywhere except Ontario and Quebec
  • 市鎮警察Municipal police也在一些市鎮服務；各省都有市警察局Also serves some municipalities; every province has municipal police departments
  • 象徵Symbol紅色制服、Stetson 帽、Musical Ride——加拿大最知名象徵之一Red Serge, Stetson hat, Musical Ride — one of Canada's best-known symbols
  • 歷史History1873 由 Macdonald 成立 North West Mounted Police，總部 ReginaFounded in 1873 as the North West Mounted Police; headquartered in Regina
  • 你的權利Your rights可以質疑警察的服務或行為，幾乎所有警力都有申訴程序You may question the police about their service or conduct; almost all forces have a complaint process
