The First Nations have band chiefs and councillors who have major responsibilities on First Nations reserves, including housing, schools and other services. There are a number of provincial, regional and national Aboriginal organizations that are a voice for First Nations, Métis and Inuit people in their relationships with the federal, provincial and territorial governments.

各級民選官員與職責Elected officials and responsibilities

聯邦政府：民選官員是國會議員（MP）。聯邦的職責包括國防、外交政策、公民身分、警政、刑事司法、國際貿易、原住民事務，以及與省共同負責的移民、農業和環境。
Federal government: the elected officials are Members of Parliament (MPs). Federal responsibilities include national defence, foreign policy, citizenship, policing, criminal justice, international trade, Aboriginal affairs, and shared responsibility for immigration, agriculture and the environment.
省和地區政府：民選官員是立法議會議員（MLA）、國民議會議員（MNA）、省議會議員（MPP）或眾議會議員（MHA）。省的職責包括教育、醫療、自然資源、公路、安大略與魁北克的警政、財產與民事權利，以及與聯邦共同負責的移民、農業和環境。
Provincial and territorial governments: the elected officials are Members of the Legislative Assembly (MLAs), Members of the National Assembly (MNAs), Members of the Provincial Parliament (MPPs) or Members of the House of Assembly (MHAs). Provincial responsibilities include education, health care, natural resources, highways, policing in Ontario and Quebec, property and civil rights, and shared responsibility for immigration, agriculture and the environment.
市鎮（地方）政府：民選官員是市長或鄉長，以及市議員。市鎮的職責包括社會與社區健康、資源回收計畫、交通與公用事業、除雪、警政、消防和緊急服務。
Municipal (local) government: the elected officials are the Mayor or Reeve and the Councillors or Aldermen. Municipal responsibilities include social and community health, recycling programs, transportation and utilities, snow removal, policing, firefighting and emergency services.

🎧 07 聯邦選舉 Federal Elections

左中文、右英文，句對句對照。按段落左邊的 ▶ 朗讀該段；點中文任一句從那句開始念；念到哪一句，中英文同時標黃。點任何一個英文字會跳出字典卡並用慢速念這個字。空白鍵＝暫停／繼續。

釋義來源：ECDICT 開源字典＋加拿大語境補充。點其他地方或按 Esc 關閉。

聯邦選舉Federal Elections

加拿大人在選舉中投票，選出他們希望在眾議院代表自己的人。每次選舉，選民可以讓同一批眾議院議員連任，也可以選出新的人。眾議院的成員也稱為國會議員（MP）。
Canadians vote in elections for the people they want to represent them in the House of Commons. In each election, voters may re-elect the same members of the House of Commons or choose new ones. Members of the House of Commons are also known as members of Parliament or MPs.
依據國會通過的法律，聯邦選舉必須在最近一次大選之後每四年的十月第三個星期一舉行。總理可以請總督提前舉行選舉。
Under legislation passed by Parliament, federal elections must be held on the third Monday in October every four years following the most recent general election. The Prime Minister may ask the Governor General to call an earlier election.
加拿大分為 308 個選區（electoral districts，也叫 ridings 或 constituencies）。注意：308 是這本 2021 年版的數字；選區數會隨人口增加，考前請到 elections.ca 查最新總數。選區是由一位國會議員代表的地理區域。每個選區的公民選出一位國會議員，在眾議院代表他們，也代表全體加拿大人。
Canada is divided into 308 electoral districts, also known as ridings or constituencies. Note: 308 is the figure in this 2021 edition; the number of ridings grows with the population, so check elections.ca for the current total before your test. An electoral district is a geographical area represented by a member of Parliament (MP). The citizens in each electoral district elect one MP who sits in the House of Commons to represent them, as well as all Canadians.
18 歲以上的加拿大公民可以參選聯邦選舉。參選的人稱為候選人。一個選區可以有很多候選人。
Canadian citizens who are 18 years old or older may run in a federal election. The people who run for office are called candidates. There can be many candidates in an electoral district.
每個選區的人民投票給自己選擇的候選人和政黨。得票最多的候選人成為該選區的國會議員。
The people in each electoral district vote for the candidate and political party of their choice. The candidate who receives the most votes becomes the MP for that electoral district.

投票Voting

加拿大公民的特權之一就是投票權。如果你是加拿大公民、投票日當天年滿 18 歲，並且在選民名冊上，你就有資格在聯邦選舉中投票，或在聯邦公投中投票。
One of the privileges of Canadian citizenship is the right to vote. You are eligible to vote in a federal election or cast a ballot in a federal referendum if you are a Canadian citizen, at least 18 years old on voting day, and on the voters' list.
聯邦選舉和公投使用的選民名冊，是由國會的中立機構「加拿大選舉局」（Elections Canada）根據「全國選民登記冊」製作的。這是一個永久性的資料庫，記錄有資格在聯邦選舉和公投中投票的 18 歲以上加拿大公民。
The voters' lists used during federal elections and referendums are produced from the National Register of Electors by a neutral agency of Parliament called Elections Canada. This is a permanent database of Canadian citizens 18 years of age or older who are qualified to vote in federal elections and referendums.
選舉一經宣布，加拿大選舉局會寄一張「選民資訊卡」給每一位名字在全國選民登記冊上的選民。卡片上列出你投票的時間和地點，以及需要口譯或其他特殊服務時可以撥打的電話號碼。
Once an election has been called, Elections Canada mails a voter information card to each elector whose name is in the National Register of Electors. The card lists when and where you vote and the number to call if you require an interpreter or other special services.
即使你選擇不列入全國選民登記冊，或沒有收到選民資訊卡，你仍然可以隨時被加入選民名冊，包括在選舉日當天。不論是在選舉日或提前投票，都到你選民資訊卡上列出的投票站去投票。
Even if you choose not to be listed in the National Register of Electors or do not receive a voter information card, you can still be added to the voters' list at any time, including on election day. To vote either on election day or at advance polls, go to the polling station listed on your voter information card.

不記名投票Secret ballot

加拿大法律保障不記名投票的權利。這表示沒有人可以看你投票，也沒有人應該看你投給了誰。你可以選擇跟別人討論你投給誰，但沒有人——包括家人、雇主或工會代表——有權利堅持要你告訴他們你投給了誰。投票站一關閉，選務人員就立刻開票，結果會在廣播、電視和報紙上公布。
Canadian law secures the right to a secret ballot. This means that no one can watch you vote and no one should look at how you voted. You may choose to discuss how you voted with others, but no one, including family members, your employer or union representative, has the right to insist that you tell them how you voted. Immediately after the polling stations close, election officers count the ballots and the results are announced on radio and television, and in the newspapers.

選舉之後After an election

通常在選舉之後，總督會邀請在眾議院席次最多的政黨領袖組成政府。經總督任命後，這個政黨的領袖就成為總理。如果執政黨在眾議院擁有至少一半的席次，就稱為「多數政府」。如果執政黨在眾議院的席次不到一半，就稱為「少數政府」。
Ordinarily, after an election, the leader of the political party with the most seats in the House of Commons is invited by the Governor General to form the government. After being appointed by the Governor General, the leader of this party becomes the Prime Minister. If the party in power holds at least half of the seats in the House of Commons, this is called a majority government. If the party in power holds less than half of the seats in the House of Commons, this is called a minority government.
只要獲得多數國會議員的支持或信任，總理和執政黨就能繼續執政。當眾議院就預算等重大議題投票時，這被視為信任投票。如果多數眾議院議員投票反對政府的重大決定，執政黨就被擊敗，通常會導致總理請總督代表君主宣布舉行選舉。
The Prime Minister and the party in power run the government as long as they have the support or confidence of the majority of the MPs. When the House of Commons votes on a major issue such as the budget, this is considered a matter of confidence. If a majority of the members of the House of Commons vote against a major government decision, the party in power is defeated, which usually results in the Prime Minister asking the Governor General, on behalf of the Sovereign, to call an election.
總理挑選各部部長，大多數來自眾議院議員。內閣部長負責管理聯邦政府各部門。總理和內閣部長合稱「內閣」，他們對國家如何治理做出重要決定。他們編列預算，並提出大多數的新法律。他們的決定可以受到所有眾議院議員的質詢。
The Prime Minister chooses the ministers of the Crown, most of them from among members of the House of Commons. Cabinet ministers are responsible for running the federal government departments. The Prime Minister and the Cabinet ministers are called the Cabinet and they make important decisions about how the country is governed. They prepare the budget and propose most new laws. Their decisions can be questioned by all members of the House of Commons.
其他沒有執政的政黨稱為反對黨。在眾議院席次最多的反對黨是「官方反對黨」，或稱「女王陛下的忠誠反對黨」。反對黨的角色是和平地反對政府的提案，或設法改善它們。目前在眾議院有席次的三大政黨是：保守黨、新民主黨和自由黨。
The other parties that are not in power are known as opposition parties. The opposition party with the most members of the House of Commons is the Official Opposition or Her Majesty's Loyal Opposition. The role of opposition parties is to peacefully oppose or try to improve government proposals. There are three major political parties currently represented in the House of Commons: the Conservative Party, the New Democratic Party, and the Liberal Party.

選舉期間的投票程序Voting procedures during an election period

第一步：選民資訊卡。資料在全國選民登記冊上的選民會收到一張選民資訊卡。這張卡確認你的名字在選民名冊上，並說明你投票的時間和地點。
Step 1: Voter information card. Electors whose information is in the National Register of Electors will receive a voter information card. This confirms that your name is on the voters' list and states when and where you vote.
第二步：我沒收到卡。如果你沒有收到選民資訊卡，請打電話給當地的選舉辦公室，確認你在選民名冊上。如果你沒有電話號碼，請撥打渥太華的加拿大選舉局：1-800-463-6868。
Step 2: I did not get a card. If you do not receive a voter information card, call your local elections office to ensure that you are on the voters' list. If you do not have the number, call Elections Canada, in Ottawa, at 1-800-463-6868.
第三步：提前投票與特別選票。如果你在選舉日不能或不想投票，可以提前投票，或用特別選票投票。日期和地點都在你的選民資訊卡上。
Step 3: Advance poll and special ballot. If you cannot or do not wish to vote on election day, you can vote at the advance polls or by special ballot. The dates and location are on your voter information card.
第四步：選舉日當天。前往你的投票站。地點在你的選民資訊卡上。帶著這張卡，以及你的身分和地址證明到投票站。
Step 4: On election day. Go to your polling station. The location is on your voter information card. Bring this card and proof of your identity and address to the polling station.
第五步：畫選票。在你選擇的候選人姓名旁邊的圓圈裡畫一個「X」。
Step 5: Marking the ballot. Mark an "X" in the circle next to the name of the candidate of your choice.
第六步：投票是不記名的。你的投票是秘密的。你會被請到遮板後面畫選票。畫好後，把選票摺起來，交給投票站的工作人員。
Step 6: Voting is secret. Your vote is secret. You will be invited to go behind the screen to mark your ballot. Once marked, fold it and present it to the poll officials.
第七步：投票箱。工作人員會撕下選票編號，再把選票交還給你，由你投進投票箱。
Step 7: The ballot box. The poll official will tear off the ballot number and give your ballot back to you to deposit in the ballot box.
第八步：選舉結果。投票結束後，每一張選票都會被計算，結果會公開。你可以在電視上或加拿大選舉局的網站上看到結果。
Step 8: The election results. When the polls close, every ballot is counted and the results are made public. You can see the results on television or on the Elections Canada website.

🎧 08 司法系統 The Justice System

左中文、右英文，句對句對照。按段落左邊的 ▶ 朗讀該段；點中文任一句從那句開始念；念到哪一句，中英文同時標黃。點任何一個英文字會跳出字典卡並用慢速念這個字。空白鍵＝暫停／繼續。

釋義來源：ECDICT 開源字典＋加拿大語境補充。點其他地方或按 Esc 關閉。

司法系統The Justice System

加拿大的司法系統保障每個人依法享有正當程序。我們的司法制度在刑事案件上建立在「無罪推定」的基礎上，意思是每個人在被證明有罪之前都是無辜的。
The Canadian justice system guarantees everyone due process under the law. Our judicial system is founded on the presumption of innocence in criminal matters, meaning everyone is innocent until proven guilty.
加拿大的法律制度建立在一項傳統之上，包括法治、法律之下的自由、民主原則和正當程序。正當程序的原則是：政府必須尊重一個人依法享有的所有法律權利。
Canada's legal system is based on a heritage that includes the rule of law, freedom under the law, democratic principles and due process. Due process is the principle that the government must respect all the legal rights a person is entitled to under the law.
加拿大由一套有系統的法律來治理。這些法律是為了引導社會中的人們而制定的成文規則。它們由民選的代表制定。法院解決糾紛，警察執行法律。加拿大的法律適用於每一個人，包括法官、政治人物和警察。我們的法律旨在為社會提供秩序、提供和平解決糾紛的方式，並表達加拿大人的價值觀與信念。
Canada is governed by an organized system of laws. These laws are the written rules intended to guide people in our society. They are made by elected representatives. The courts settle disputes and the police enforce the laws. The law in Canada applies to everyone, including judges, politicians and the police. Our laws are intended to provide order in society and a peaceful way to settle disputes, and to express the values and beliefs of Canadians.
蒙著眼睛的正義女神象徵我們法律執行的公正方式：除了事實之外，對一切考量都視而不見。
The blindfolded Lady Justice symbolizes the impartial manner in which our laws are administered: blind to all considerations but the facts.

法院Courts

加拿大最高法院是我們國家的最高法院。加拿大聯邦法院處理與聯邦政府有關的事務。大多數省份有上訴法院和審判法院，審判法院有時稱為「女王座法院」或「最高法院」。另外還有審理較輕罪行的省法院、家事法院、交通法院，以及審理小額民事案件的小額索賠法院。
The Supreme Court of Canada is our country's highest court. The Federal Court of Canada deals with matters concerning the federal government. In most provinces there is an appeal court and a trial court, sometimes called the Court of Queen's Bench or the Supreme Court. There are also provincial courts for lesser offences, family courts, traffic courts and small claims courts for civil cases involving small sums of money.

警察Police

警察的職責是保護人民安全並執行法律。在各種情況下你都可以向警察求助——發生意外、東西被偷、遭到攻擊、目睹犯罪，或認識的人失蹤時。
The police are there to keep people safe and to enforce the law. You can ask the police for help in all kinds of situations—if there's been an accident, if someone has stolen something from you, if you are a victim of assault, if you see a crime taking place or if someone you know has gone missing.
加拿大有不同種類的警察。安大略和魁北克有省警察，所有省份都有市警察局。皇家加拿大騎警（RCMP）在全加拿大執行聯邦法律，並在安大略和魁北克以外的所有省和地區擔任省警察，也在一些市鎮服務。記住，警察是來幫助你的。
There are different types of police in Canada. There are provincial police forces in Ontario and Quebec and municipal police departments in all provinces. The Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) enforce federal laws throughout Canada, and serve as the provincial police in all provinces and territories except Ontario and Quebec, as well as in some municipalities. Remember, the police are there to help you.
如果你覺得有必要，你也可以就警察的服務或行為提出質疑。加拿大幾乎所有警察機關都有一套程序，讓你可以向警方反映你的疑慮並要求處理。
You can also question the police about their service or conduct if you feel you need to. Almost all police forces in Canada have a process by which you can bring your concerns to the police and seek action.
監獄在懲罰罪犯和嚇阻犯罪方面扮演重要角色。
Prisons have an essential role in punishing criminals and deterring crime.

尋求法律協助Getting legal help

律師可以幫你處理法律問題，並在法庭上代表你。如果你付不起律師費，大多數社區都有免費或低收費的法律援助服務。
Lawyers can help you with legal problems and act for you in court. If you cannot pay for a lawyer, in most communities there are legal aid services available free of charge or at a low cost.

🎧 09 加拿大的象徵 Canadian Symbols

左中文、右英文，句對句對照。按段落左邊的 ▶ 朗讀該段；點中文任一句從那句開始念；念到哪一句，中英文同時標黃。點任何一個英文字會跳出字典卡並用慢速念這個字。空白鍵＝暫停／繼續。

釋義來源：ECDICT 開源字典＋加拿大語境補充。點其他地方或按 Esc 關閉。

加拿大的象徵Canadian Symbols

加拿大有許多重要的象徵——具有特殊意義的物品、事件和人物。它們共同幫助說明身為加拿大人的意義，並表達我們的國家認同。重要的加拿大象徵出現在這本手冊的各個地方。
Canada has many important symbols — objects, events, and people that have special meaning. Together they help explain what it means to be Canadian and express our national identity. Important Canadian symbols appear throughout this booklet.

加拿大的王權The Canadian Crown

四百年來，王權一直是加拿大國家的象徵。自 1867 年維多利亞女王在位期間的聯邦成立以來，加拿大本身就是一個君主立憲國。伊莉莎白二世女王自 1952 年起擔任加拿大女王，2002 年慶祝登基金禧，2012 年慶祝鑽禧（在位 60 年）。注意：伊莉莎白二世女王於 2022 年 9 月過世，現在加拿大的國王是查理三世。王權是政府的象徵，包括國會、各級議會、法院、警察機關和加拿大軍隊。
The Crown has been a symbol of the state in Canada for 400 years. Canada has been a constitutional monarchy in its own right since Confederation in 1867 during Queen Victoria's reign. Queen Elizabeth II, who has been Queen of Canada since 1952, marked her Golden Jubilee in 2002, and celebrates her Diamond Jubilee (60 years as Sovereign) in 2012. Note: Queen Elizabeth II died in September 2022; King Charles III is now King of Canada. The Crown is a symbol of government, including Parliament, the legislatures, the courts, police services and the Canadian Forces.

加拿大的旗幟Flags in Canada

新的加拿大國旗在 1965 年第一次升起。紅－白－紅的圖案來自 1876 年創立的京士頓皇家軍事學院的旗幟。紅色和白色自中世紀以來就是法國和英國的顏色，自 1921 年起成為加拿大的國家代表色。英國國旗（Union Jack）是我們正式的王室旗幟。加拿大紅船旗（Canadian Red Ensign）曾作為加拿大國旗約一百年。各省和地區也有體現各自獨特傳統的旗幟。
A new Canadian flag was raised for the first time in 1965. The red-white-red pattern comes from the flag of the Royal Military College, Kingston, founded in 1876. Red and white had been colours of France and England since the Middle Ages and the national colours of Canada since 1921. The Union Jack is our official Royal Flag. The Canadian Red Ensign served as the Canadian flag for about 100 years. The provinces and territories also have flags that embody their distinct traditions.

楓葉The maple leaf

楓葉是加拿大最著名的象徵。楓葉在 1700 年代被法裔加拿大人採用為象徵，自 1850 年代起出現在加拿大的軍服和徽章上，也刻在我們安葬於海外和加拿大的陣亡將士墓碑上。
The maple leaf is Canada's best-known symbol. Maple leaves were adopted as a symbol by French Canadians in the 1700s, have appeared on Canadian uniforms and insignia since the 1850s, and are carved into the headstones of our fallen soldiers buried overseas and in Canada.

百合花飾The fleur-de-lys

據說百合花飾（fleur-de-lys）是法國國王在西元 496 年採用的。它成為法國王室的象徵超過一千年，包括新法蘭西殖民地時期。在聯邦成立時重新啟用，百合花飾被納入加拿大紅船旗。1948 年，魁北克採用了自己的省旗，以十字和百合花飾為基礎。
It is said that the lily flower ("fleur-de-lys") was adopted by the French king in the year 496. It became the symbol of French royalty for more than 1,000 years, including the colony of New France. Revived at Confederation, the fleur-de-lys was included in the Canadian Red Ensign. In 1948 Quebec adopted its own flag, based on the Cross and the fleur-de-lys.

國徽與國家格言Coat of arms and motto

第一次世界大戰後，為了表達國家的驕傲，加拿大採用了正式的國徽和國家格言「A mari usque ad mare」，拉丁文的意思是「從海到海」。國徽包含英格蘭、法國、蘇格蘭和愛爾蘭的象徵，以及紅色楓葉。今天可以在紙鈔、政府文件和公共建築上看到國徽。
As an expression of national pride after the First World War, Canada adopted an official coat of arms and a national motto, A mari usque ad mare, which in Latin means "from sea to sea." The arms contain symbols of England, France, Scotland and Ireland as well as red maple leaves. Today the arms can be seen on dollar bills, government documents and public buildings.

國會大廈Parliament buildings

國會大廈的塔樓、拱門、雕塑和彩繪玻璃，體現了法國、英國和原住民的傳統，以及維多利亞女王時代流行的哥德復興式建築。這些建築在 1860 年代完工。中央大樓在 1916 年因意外火災被毀，1922 年重建。圖書館是原始建築唯一保留下來的部分。和平塔於 1927 年完工，紀念第一次世界大戰。塔內的紀念廳存放著《紀念名冊》，上面寫著在戰爭中或執勤時為加拿大犧牲的陸海空軍將士的名字。
The towers, arches, sculptures and stained glass of the Parliament Buildings embody the French, English and Aboriginal traditions and the Gothic Revival architecture popular in the time of Queen Victoria. The buildings were completed in the 1860s. The Centre Block was destroyed by an accidental fire in 1916 and rebuilt in 1922. The Library is the only part of the original building remaining. The Peace Tower was completed in 1927 in memory of the First World War. The Memorial Chamber within the Tower contains the Books of Remembrance in which are written the names of soldiers, sailors and airmen who died serving Canada in wars or while on duty.
各省的議會大廈都是建築珍寶。魁北克國民議會採用法國第二帝國風格，其他省的議會大廈則是巴洛克、羅馬式和新古典主義風格，反映了民主起源的西方文明的希臘羅馬傳統。
The provincial legislatures are architectural treasures. The Quebec National Assembly is built in the French Second Empire style, while the legislatures of the other provinces are Baroque, Romanesque and neoclassical, reflecting the Greco-Roman heritage of Western civilization in which democracy originated.

熱門運動Popular sports

曲棍球是加拿大最受歡迎的觀賞運動，被視為國家冬季運動。冰上曲棍球是 1800 年代在加拿大發展起來的。國家冰球聯盟爭奪冠軍「史丹利盃」，這座獎盃是總督史丹利勳爵在 1892 年捐贈的。「克拉克森盃」由第 26 任總督伍冰枝（Adrienne Clarkson，第一位亞裔總督）在 2005 年設立，頒給女子曲棍球。許多加拿大年輕人在學校、曲棍球聯盟或安靜的街道上打曲棍球——路上曲棍球或街頭曲棍球——父母也會帶他們去溜冰場。加拿大的孩子們世世代代都收集曲棍球卡。
Hockey is Canada's most popular spectator sport and is considered to be the national winter sport. Ice hockey was developed in Canada in the 1800s. The National Hockey League plays for the championship Stanley Cup, donated by Lord Stanley, the Governor General, in 1892. The Clarkson Cup, established in 2005 by Adrienne Clarkson, the 26th Governor General (and the first of Asian origin), is awarded for women's hockey. Many young Canadians play hockey at school, in a hockey league or on quiet streets—road hockey or street hockey—and are taken to the hockey rink by their parents. Canadian children have collected hockey cards for generations.
加拿大式足球是第二受歡迎的運動。冰壺，一種由蘇格蘭拓荒者引進的冰上運動，很受歡迎。袋棍球（lacrosse），一種最早由原住民玩的古老運動，是官方的夏季運動。足球是加拿大註冊球員最多的運動。
Canadian football is the second most popular sport. Curling, an ice game introduced by Scottish pioneers, is popular. Lacrosse, an ancient sport first played by Aboriginals, is the official summer sport. Soccer has the most registered players of any game in Canada.

海狸The beaver

幾百年前，海狸被哈德遜灣公司採用為象徵。1834 年，它成為法裔加拿大愛國組織「聖讓－巴蒂斯特協會」的標誌，其他團體也採用它。這種勤勞的齧齒動物出現在五分硬幣上、薩克其萬和亞伯達的省徽上，以及蒙特婁和多倫多等城市的市徽上。
The beaver was adopted centuries ago as a symbol of the Hudson's Bay Company. It became an emblem of the St. Jean Baptiste Society, a French-Canadian patriotic association, in 1834, and was also adopted by other groups. This industrious rodent can be seen on the five-cent coin, on the coats of arms of Saskatchewan and Alberta, and of cities such as Montreal and Toronto.

加拿大的官方語言Canada's official languages

英語和法語是兩種官方語言，也是重要的身分象徵。說英語的人和說法語的人在夥伴關係與良性張力中共同生活了三百多年。要成為加拿大公民，你必須具備足夠的英語或法語能力。55 歲以上的成年申請人免除這項要求。
English and French are the two official languages and are important symbols of identity. English speakers (Anglophones) and French speakers (Francophones) have lived together in partnership and creative tension for more than 300 years. You must have adequate knowledge of English or French to become a Canadian citizen. Adult applicants 55 years of age or over are exempted from this requirement.
國會在 1969 年通過《官方語言法》。它有三個主要目標：在國會、加拿大政府和受該法規範的機構中，建立法語和英語的平等。維持並發展加拿大的官方語言少數社群。在加拿大社會中促進法語和英語的平等。
Parliament passed the Official Languages Act in 1969. It has three main objectives: Establish equality between French and English in Parliament, the Government of Canada and institutions subject to the Act. Maintain and develop official language minority communities in Canada. Promote equality of French and English in Canadian society.

國歌National Anthem

《噢！加拿大》在 1980 年被宣布為國歌。它在 1880 年首次於魁北克市演唱。法裔和英裔加拿大人唱的國歌歌詞不同。
O Canada was proclaimed as the national anthem in 1980. It was first sung in Québec City in 1880. French and English Canadians sing different words to the national anthem.
噢！加拿大！我們的家園與故土！你所有的兒女滿懷真摯的愛國心。我們懷著熱切的心看著你崛起，真正的北方，強大而自由！從四面八方，噢！加拿大，我們為你守望。願上帝保佑我們的土地光榮而自由！噢！加拿大，我們為你守望。噢！加拿大，我們為你守望。注意：2018 年起，官方英文歌詞把「in all thy sons command」改成「in all of us command」。
O Canada! Our home and native land! True patriot love in all thy sons command. With glowing hearts we see thee rise, the true North strong and free! From far and wide, O Canada, we stand on guard for thee. God keep our land glorious and free! O Canada, we stand on guard for thee. O Canada, we stand on guard for thee. Note: since 2018 the official English lyric is "in all of us command" instead of "in all thy sons command."

皇家國歌Royal Anthem

加拿大的皇家國歌《天佑女王（或國王）》，可以在加拿大人想向君主致敬的任何場合演奏或演唱。天佑我們仁慈的女王！我們高貴的女王萬歲！天佑女王！願她勝利、幸福而光榮，長久統治我們，天佑女王！
The Royal Anthem of Canada, "God Save the Queen (or King)," can be played or sung on any occasion when Canadians wish to honour the Sovereign. God save our gracious Queen! Long live our noble Queen! God save the Queen! Send her victorious, happy and glorious, long to reign over us, God save the Queen!

加拿大勳章與其他榮譽The Order of Canada and other honours

所有國家都有表彰傑出公民的方式。官方的獎勵稱為「榮譽」，包括勳章、勳飾和獎章。在使用英國榮譽制度多年之後，加拿大在 1967 年——聯邦成立一百週年——以「加拿大勳章」開始了自己的榮譽制度。如果你認識值得表彰的公民，歡迎提名他們。
All countries have ways to recognize outstanding citizens. Official awards are called honours, consisting of orders, decorations and medals. After using British honours for many years, Canada started its own honours system with the Order of Canada in 1967, the centennial of Confederation. If you know of fellow citizens who you think are worthy of recognition, you are welcome to nominate them.

維多利亞十字勳章The Victoria Cross

維多利亞十字勳章（V.C.）是加拿大人能獲得的最高榮譽，頒給在敵人面前表現出最卓越的勇敢、英勇或自我犧牲的行為，或極度忠於職守的人。自 1854 年以來，已有 96 位加拿大人獲頒維多利亞十字勳章，包括：當時的中尉亞歷山大・羅伯茨・鄧恩（Alexander Roberts Dunn），生於今天的多倫多，在克里米亞戰爭中隨英軍參加 1854 年巴拉克拉瓦的輕騎兵衝鋒，是第一位獲頒維多利亞十字勳章的加拿大人。新斯科細亞霍頓的一等水兵威廉・霍爾（William Hall），父母是美國奴隸，因在 1857 年印度起義的勒克瑙圍城戰中的表現，成為第一位獲頒 V.C. 的黑人。生於烏克蘭的下士菲利普・科諾瓦爾（Filip Konowal），在 1917 年的 70 高地戰役中展現非凡的勇氣，成為加拿大軍團中第一位非大英帝國出生而獲頒 V.C. 的人。王牌飛行員比利・畢曉普上尉（Billy Bishop），生於安大略歐文桑德，在第一次世界大戰中於皇家飛行隊獲頒 V.C.，後來成為皇家加拿大空軍的榮譽空軍元帥。魁北克卡巴諾的保羅・特里凱上尉（Paul Triquet），在第二次世界大戰 1943 年義大利的卡薩貝拉爾迪攻擊戰中率領部下和幾輛坦克，獲頒 V.C.，後來成為准將。生於卑詩省特雷爾的海軍飛行員羅伯特・漢普頓・格雷中尉（Robert Hampton Gray），在 1945 年 8 月第二次世界大戰結束前幾天轟炸並擊沉一艘日本軍艦時陣亡，是至今最後一位獲頒 V.C. 的加拿大人。
The Victoria Cross (V.C.) is the highest honour available to Canadians and is awarded for the most conspicuous bravery, a daring or pre-eminent act of valour or self-sacrifice, or extreme devotion to duty in the presence of the enemy. The V.C. has been awarded to 96 Canadians since 1854, including: Then Lieutenant Alexander Roberts Dunn, born in present-day Toronto, served in the British Army in the Charge of the Light Brigade at Balaclava (1854) in the Crimean War, and was the first Canadian to be awarded the Victoria Cross. Able Seaman William Hall of Horton, Nova Scotia, whose parents were American slaves, was the first black man to be awarded the V.C. for his role in the Siege of Lucknow during the Indian Rebellion of 1857. Corporal Filip Konowal, born in Ukraine, showed exceptional courage in the Battle of Hill 70 in 1917, and became the first member of the Canadian Corps not born in the British Empire to be awarded the V.C. Flying ace Captain Billy Bishop, born in Owen Sound, Ontario, earned the V.C. in the Royal Flying Corps during the First World War, and was later an honorary Air Marshal of the Royal Canadian Air Force. Captain Paul Triquet of Cabano, Quebec, earned the V.C. leading his men and a handful of tanks in the attack on Casa Berardi in Italy in 1943 during the Second World War, and was later a Brigadier. Lieutenant Robert Hampton Gray, a navy pilot born in Trail, B.C., was killed while bombing and sinking a Japanese warship in August 1945, a few days before the end of the Second World War, and was the last Canadian to receive the V.C. to date.

國定假日與其他重要日期National Public Holidays and Other Important Dates

元旦：1 月 1 日。約翰・A・麥克唐納爵士日：1 月 11 日。耶穌受難日：復活節星期日之前的星期五。復活節星期一：復活節星期日之後的星期一。維米日：4 月 9 日。維多利亞日：5 月 25 日之前的星期一（君主誕辰）。魁北克國慶日：6 月 24 日（施洗者聖約翰節）。加拿大日：7 月 1 日。勞動節：9 月的第一個星期一。感恩節：10 月的第二個星期一。國殤紀念日：11 月 11 日。威爾弗里德・勞里埃爵士日：11 月 20 日。聖誕節：12 月 25 日。節禮日：12 月 26 日。注意：2021 年起，9 月 30 日也是「全國真相與和解日」。
New Year's Day: January 1. Sir John A. Macdonald Day: January 11. Good Friday: Friday immediately preceding Easter Sunday. Easter Monday: Monday immediately following Easter Sunday. Vimy Day: April 9. Victoria Day: Monday preceding May 25 (Sovereign's birthday). Fête nationale (Quebec): June 24 (Feast of St. John the Baptist). Canada Day: July 1. Labour Day: First Monday of September. Thanksgiving Day: Second Monday of October. Remembrance Day: November 11. Sir Wilfrid Laurier Day: November 20. Christmas Day: December 25. Boxing Day: December 26. Note: since 2021, September 30 is also the National Day for Truth and Reconciliation.

🎧 10 加拿大的經濟 Canada's Economy

左中文、右英文，句對句對照。按段落左邊的 ▶ 朗讀該段；點中文任一句從那句開始念；念到哪一句，中英文同時標黃。點任何一個英文字會跳出字典卡並用慢速念這個字。空白鍵＝暫停／繼續。

釋義來源：ECDICT 開源字典＋加拿大語境補充。點其他地方或按 Esc 關閉。

貿易之國A trading nation

加拿大一直是一個貿易國家，商業仍然是經濟成長的引擎。身為加拿大人，如果不與其他國家貿易，我們就無法維持我們的生活水準。
Canada has always been a trading nation and commerce remains the engine of economic growth. As Canadians, we could not maintain our standard of living without engaging in trade with other nations.
1988 年，加拿大與美國實施自由貿易。1994 年，墨西哥加入更大範圍的《北美自由貿易協定》（NAFTA），涵蓋超過 4 億 4 千 4 百萬人口，2008 年的商品貿易額超過一兆美元。注意：NAFTA 在 2020 年被《加美墨協定》（CUSMA）取代。
In 1988, Canada enacted free trade with the United States. Mexico became a partner in 1994 in the broader North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA), with over 444 million people and over $1 trillion in merchandise trade in 2008. Note: NAFTA was replaced in 2020 by the Canada-United States-Mexico Agreement (CUSMA).
今天，加拿大是世界十大經濟體之一，也是主要工業化國家 G8 的成員，其他成員有美國、德國、英國、義大利、法國、日本和俄羅斯。注意：2014 年俄羅斯被停權後，這個組織就變成 G7。
Today, Canada has one of the ten largest economies in the world and is part of the G8 group of leading industrialized countries with the United States, Germany, the United Kingdom, Italy, France, Japan and Russia. Note: since Russia's suspension in 2014 the group has been the G7.

三大產業類型Three main types of industries

加拿大的經濟包括三大類產業：服務業在運輸、教育、醫療、建築、銀行、通訊、零售、旅遊和政府等領域提供成千上萬種不同的工作。現在超過 75% 的加拿大就業人口從事服務業。
Canada's economy includes three main types of industries: Service industries provide thousands of different jobs in areas like transportation, education, health care, construction, banking, communications, retail services, tourism and government. More than 75% of working Canadians now have jobs in service industries.
製造業生產產品，在加拿大和世界各地銷售。製造的產品包括紙張、高科技設備、航太技術、汽車、機械、食品、衣物和許多其他商品。我們最大的國際貿易夥伴是美國。
Manufacturing industries make products to sell in Canada and around the world. Manufactured products include paper, high technology equipment, aerospace technology, automobiles, machinery, food, clothing and many other goods. Our largest international trading partner is the United States.
自然資源產業包括林業、漁業、農業、礦業和能源。這些產業在國家的歷史和發展中扮演了重要角色。今天，國內許多地區的經濟仍依賴開發自然資源，加拿大出口中有很大一部分是自然資源商品。
Natural resources industries include forestry, fishing, agriculture, mining and energy. These industries have played an important part in the country's history and development. Today, the economy of many areas of the country still depends on developing natural resources, and a large percentage of Canada's exports are natural resources commodities.

加拿大與美國Canada and the United States

加拿大與美國關係密切，彼此都是對方最大的貿易夥伴。加拿大超過四分之三的出口銷往美國。事實上，我們擁有世界上最大的雙邊貿易關係。加美一體化的供應鏈與世界其他地區競爭。加拿大每年出口價值數十億美元的能源產品、工業品、機械、設備、汽車、農產品、漁產品、林產品和消費品。每年有數百萬加拿大人和美國人安全地穿越這條傳統上被稱為「世界最長不設防邊界」的國界。
Canada enjoys close relations with the United States and each is the other's largest trading partner. Over three-quarters of Canadian exports are destined for the U.S.A. In fact we have the biggest bilateral trading relationship in the world. Integrated Canada-U.S.A. supply chains compete with the rest of the world. Canada exports billions of dollars worth of energy products, industrial goods, machinery, equipment, automotive, agricultural, fishing and forestry products, and consumer goods every year. Millions of Canadians and Americans cross every year and in safety what is traditionally known as "the world's longest undefended border."
在華盛頓州的布萊恩，「和平拱門」上刻著「同一位母親的子女」和「兄弟和睦同居」的字句，象徵著我們緊密的關係和共同的利益。
At Blaine in the State of Washington, the Peace Arch, inscribed with the words "children of a common mother" and "brethren dwelling together in unity," symbolizes our close ties and common interests.

🎧 11 加拿大的各個地區 Canada's Regions

左中文、右英文，句對句對照。按段落左邊的 ▶ 朗讀該段；點中文任一句從那句開始念；念到哪一句，中英文同時標黃。點任何一個英文字會跳出字典卡並用慢速念這個字。空白鍵＝暫停／繼續。

釋義來源：ECDICT 開源字典＋加拿大語境補充。點其他地方或按 Esc 關閉。

加拿大的各個地區Canada's Regions

加拿大是地球上第二大的國家——一千萬平方公里。三個大洋環繞加拿大的邊界：西邊是太平洋，東邊是大西洋，北邊是北冰洋。加拿大的南緣是加拿大與美國的邊界。加拿大和美國都致力於維持一條安全、穩固而有效率的邊界。
Canada is the second largest country on earth—10 million square kilometres. Three oceans line Canada's frontiers: the Pacific Ocean in the west, the Atlantic Ocean in the east, and the Arctic Ocean to the north. Along the southern edge of Canada lies the Canada-United States boundary. Both Canada and the U.S.A. are committed to a safe, secure and efficient frontier.

加拿大的五大區域The Regions of Canada

加拿大包含許多不同的地理區域，分為五個不同的區域：大西洋省份、中部加拿大、草原省份、西海岸，以及北方地區。
Canada includes many different geographical areas and five distinct regions: the Atlantic Provinces, Central Canada, the Prairie Provinces, the West Coast, and the Northern Territories.

國家首都The National Capital

位於渥太華河畔的渥太華，在 1857 年由伊莉莎白二世女王的高祖母維多利亞女王選為首都。今天它是加拿大第四大都會區。環繞渥太華、面積 4,700 平方公里的國家首都區，保存並提升該地區的建築遺產和自然環境。
Ottawa, located on the Ottawa River, was chosen as the capital in 1857 by Queen Victoria, the great-great-grandmother of Queen Elizabeth II. Today it is Canada's fourth largest metropolitan area. The National Capital Region, 4,700 square kilometres surrounding Ottawa, preserves and enhances the area's built heritage and natural environment.

省與地區Provinces and Territories

加拿大有十個省和三個地區。每個省和地區都有自己的首府。你應該知道自己所在省或地區的首府，以及加拿大的首都。
Canada has ten provinces and three territories. Each province and territory has its own capital city. You should know the capital of your province or territory as well as that of Canada.
大西洋省份：紐芬蘭與拉布拉多，首府聖約翰斯（St. John's）；愛德華王子島，首府夏洛特敦（Charlottetown）；新斯科細亞，首府哈利法克斯（Halifax）；新布藍瑞克，首府弗雷德里克頓（Fredericton）。中部加拿大：魁北克，首府魁北克市（Québec City）；安大略，首府多倫多（Toronto）。草原省份：曼尼托巴，首府溫尼伯（Winnipeg）；薩克其萬，首府里賈納（Regina）；亞伯達，首府艾德蒙頓（Edmonton）。西海岸：卑詩省，首府維多利亞（Victoria）。北方：努納福特，首府伊魁特（Iqaluit）；西北地區，首府黃刀鎮（Yellowknife）；育空地區，首府白馬市（Whitehorse）。
Atlantic Provinces: Newfoundland and Labrador, capital St. John's; Prince Edward Island, capital Charlottetown; Nova Scotia, capital Halifax; New Brunswick, capital Fredericton. Central Canada: Quebec, capital Québec City; Ontario, capital Toronto. Prairie Provinces: Manitoba, capital Winnipeg; Saskatchewan, capital Regina; Alberta, capital Edmonton. West Coast: British Columbia, capital Victoria. North: Nunavut, capital Iqaluit; Northwest Territories, capital Yellowknife; Yukon Territory, capital Whitehorse.

人口Population

加拿大的人口約三千四百萬。雖然大多數人住在城市，加拿大人也住在小鎮、鄉村，以及介於兩者之間的各種地方。注意：這是 2021 年版的數字；加拿大人口在 2023 年已突破四千萬。
Canada has a population of about 34 million people. While the majority live in cities, Canadians also live in small towns, rural areas and everywhere in between. Note: this is the 2021 edition's figure; Canada passed 40 million people in 2023.

大西洋省份The Atlantic Provinces

大西洋加拿大的海岸和自然資源——包括漁業、農業、林業和礦業——使這些省份成為加拿大歷史與發展的重要部分。大西洋帶來涼爽的冬天和涼爽潮濕的夏天。
Atlantic Canada's coasts and natural resources, including fishing, farming, forestry and mining, have made these provinces an important part of Canada's history and development. The Atlantic Ocean brings cool winters and cool humid summers.
紐芬蘭與拉布拉多（Newfoundland and Labrador）是北美洲最東端，有自己的時區。除了自然美景，這個省還有與海洋相連的獨特傳承。作為大英帝國最古老的殖民地、加拿大早期歷史中的戰略要地，這個省長期以來以漁業、沿海漁村和獨特的文化聞名。今天，海上石油和天然氣開採占經濟相當大的一部分。拉布拉多也有巨大的水力發電資源。
Newfoundland and Labrador is the most easterly point in North America and has its own time zone. In addition to its natural beauty, the province has a unique heritage linked to the sea. The oldest colony of the British Empire and a strategic prize in Canada's early history, the province has long been known for its fisheries, coastal fishing villages and distinct culture. Today off-shore oil and gas extraction contributes a substantial part of the economy. Labrador also has immense hydro-electric resources.
愛德華王子島（Prince Edward Island，P.E.I.）是最小的省，以海灘、紅土和農業聞名，尤其是馬鈴薯。愛德華王子島是聯邦的誕生地，由世界上最長的連續多跨橋之一「聯邦大橋」與加拿大本土相連。露西・莫德・蒙哥馬利（Lucy Maud Montgomery）以愛德華王子島為背景的《清秀佳人》（Anne of Green Gables），是一個深受喜愛的故事，講述一個紅髮小孤女的冒險。
Prince Edward Island (P.E.I.) is the smallest province, known for its beaches, red soil and agriculture, especially potatoes. P.E.I. is the birthplace of Confederation, connected to mainland Canada by one of the longest continuous multispan bridges in the world, the Confederation Bridge. Anne of Green Gables, set in P.E.I. by Lucy Maud Montgomery, is a much-loved story about the adventures of a little red-headed orphan girl.
新斯科細亞（Nova Scotia）是人口最多的大西洋省份，作為加拿大的門戶有豐富的歷史。以芬迪灣世界最高的潮汐聞名，這個省的身分與造船、漁業和航運息息相關。首府哈利法克斯是加拿大東岸最大的港口，水深且終年不結冰，在大西洋貿易和國防上扮演重要角色，也是加拿大最大海軍基地的所在地。新斯科細亞有悠久的煤礦、林業和農業歷史。今天也有海上石油和天然氣的探勘。這個省的凱爾特和蓋爾傳統維繫著充滿活力的文化。新斯科細亞每年有超過 700 個節慶，包括哈利法克斯壯觀的軍樂表演。
Nova Scotia is the most populous Atlantic Province, with a rich history as the gateway to Canada. Known for the world's highest tides in the Bay of Fundy, the province's identity is linked to shipbuilding, fisheries and shipping. As Canada's largest east coast port, deep-water and ice-free, the capital, Halifax, has played an important role in Atlantic trade and defence and is home to Canada's largest naval base. Nova Scotia has a long history of coal mining, forestry and agriculture. Today there is also off-shore oil and gas exploration. The province's Celtic and Gaelic traditions sustain a vibrant culture. Nova Scotia is home to over 700 annual festivals, including the spectacular military tattoo in Halifax.
位於阿帕拉契山脈的新布藍瑞克（New Brunswick），由聯合帝國效忠派建立，擁有北美大西洋沿岸第二大的河流系統——聖約翰河系統。林業、農業、漁業、礦業、食品加工和旅遊業是主要產業。聖約翰（Saint John）是最大的城市、港口和製造中心；蒙克頓（Moncton）是主要的法語阿卡迪亞中心；弗雷德里克頓（Fredericton）是歷史悠久的首府。新布藍瑞克是唯一官方雙語的省份，約三分之一的人口以法語生活和工作。這個省的效忠派拓荒者和法國文化遺產與歷史，在街頭節慶和傳統音樂中鮮活地呈現。
Situated in the Appalachian Range, New Brunswick was founded by the United Empire Loyalists and has the second largest river system on North America's Atlantic coastline, the St. John River system. Forestry, agriculture, fisheries, mining, food processing and tourism are the principal industries. Saint John is the largest city, port and manufacturing centre; Moncton is the principal Francophone Acadian centre; and Fredericton, the historic capital. New Brunswick is the only officially bilingual province, and about one-third of the population lives and works in French. The province's pioneer Loyalist and French cultural heritage and history come alive in street festivals and traditional music.

中部加拿大Central Canada

加拿大超過一半的人口住在魁北克南部和安大略五大湖與聖羅倫斯河附近的城鎮，這裡被稱為中部加拿大，是工業和製造業的心臟地帶。安大略南部和魁北克冬天寒冷，夏天溫暖潮濕。安大略和魁北克合起來生產加拿大四分之三以上的製造品。
More than half the people in Canada live in cities and towns near the Great Lakes and the St. Lawrence River in southern Quebec and Ontario, known as Central Canada and the industrial and manufacturing heartland. Southern Ontario and Quebec have cold winters and warm humid summers. Together, Ontario and Quebec produce more than three-quarters of all Canadian manufactured goods.
將近八百萬人住在魁北克（Quebec），絕大多數沿著或靠近聖羅倫斯河。超過四分之三的人以法語為第一語言。加拿大地盾的資源幫助魁北克發展了重要產業，包括林業、能源和礦業。魁北克是加拿大主要的紙漿和紙張生產地。這個省龐大的淡水資源使它成為加拿大最大的水力發電生產者。魁北克人在製藥和航空等尖端產業居於領先地位。魁北克的電影、音樂、文學作品和美食享有國際地位，尤其在法語國家組織（La Francophonie）中。蒙特婁（Montreal）是加拿大第二大城市，也是世界上僅次於巴黎的第二大法語城市，以文化多元聞名。
Nearly eight million people live in Quebec, the vast majority along or near the St. Lawrence River. More than three-quarters speak French as their first language. The resources of the Canadian Shield have helped Quebec to develop important industries, including forestry, energy and mining. Quebec is Canada's main producer of pulp and paper. The province's huge supply of fresh water has made it Canada's largest producer of hydro-electricity. Quebecers are leaders in cutting-edge industries such as pharmaceuticals and aeronautics. Quebec films, music, literary works and food have international stature, especially in La Francophonie, an association of French-speaking nations. Montreal, Canada's second largest city and the second largest mainly French-speaking city in the world after Paris, is famous for its cultural diversity.
安大略（Ontario）人口超過一千兩百萬，占加拿大人口的三分之一以上。龐大而文化多元的人口、自然資源和戰略位置，造就了充滿活力的經濟。多倫多（Toronto）是加拿大最大的城市，也是國家的主要金融中心。許多人在服務業或製造業工作，這些產業生產加拿大很大一部分的出口品。尼加拉地區以葡萄園、葡萄酒和水果作物聞名。安大略的農民飼養乳牛和肉牛、家禽，並種植蔬菜和穀物。由聯合帝國效忠派建立的安大略，也擁有魁北克以外最多的法語人口，他們以保存自己語言和文化的歷史為榮。安大略與美國之間有五大湖：安大略湖、伊利湖、休倫湖、密西根湖（在美國境內），以及世界最大的淡水湖蘇必略湖。
At more than 12 million, the people of Ontario make up more than one-third of Canadians. The large and culturally diverse population, natural resources and strategic location contribute to a vital economy. Toronto is the largest city in Canada and the country's main financial centre. Many people work in the service or manufacturing industries, which produce a large percentage of Canada's exports. The Niagara region is known for its vineyards, wines and fruit crops. Ontario farmers raise dairy and beef cattle, poultry, and vegetable and grain crops. Founded by United Empire Loyalists, Ontario also has the largest French-speaking population outside of Quebec, with a proud history of preserving their language and culture. There are five Great Lakes located between Ontario and the United States: Lake Ontario, Lake Erie, Lake Huron, Lake Michigan (in the U.S.A.) and Lake Superior, the largest freshwater lake in the world.

草原省份The Prairie Provinces

曼尼托巴、薩克其萬和亞伯達是草原省份，擁有豐富的能源資源和世界上最肥沃的農田之一。這個地區大多乾燥，冬天寒冷，夏天炎熱。
Manitoba, Saskatchewan and Alberta are the Prairie Provinces, rich in energy resources and some of the most fertile farmland in the world. The region is mostly dry, with cold winters and hot summers.
曼尼托巴（Manitoba）的經濟以農業、礦業和水力發電為基礎。這個省人口最多的城市是溫尼伯（Winnipeg），它的交易區包含加拿大最著名的十字路口——波蒂奇大道與緬街（Portage and Main）。溫尼伯的法語區聖博尼法斯（St. Boniface）擁有加拿大西部最大的法語社群，有四萬五千人。曼尼托巴也是烏克蘭文化的重要中心，14% 的人自報烏克蘭血統；它也是各省中原住民人口比例最高的，超過 15%。
Manitoba's economy is based on agriculture, mining and hydro-electric power generation. The province's most populous city is Winnipeg, whose Exchange District includes the most famous street intersection in Canada, Portage and Main. Winnipeg's French Quarter, St. Boniface, has Western Canada's largest Francophone community at 45,000. Manitoba is also an important centre of Ukrainian culture, with 14% reporting Ukrainian origins, and the largest Aboriginal population of any province, at over 15%.
薩克其萬（Saskatchewan）曾被稱為「世界的麵包籃」和「小麥之省」，擁有加拿大 40% 的可耕地，是全國最大的穀物和油籽生產地。它還擁有世界上最豐富的鈾礦和鉀鹽礦藏（鉀鹽用於肥料），也生產石油和天然氣。首府里賈納（Regina）是皇家加拿大騎警訓練學院的所在地。最大的城市薩斯卡通（Saskatoon）是礦業的總部，也是重要的教育、研究和科技中心。
Saskatchewan, once known as the "breadbasket of the world" and the "wheat province," has 40% of the arable land in Canada and is the country's largest producer of grains and oilseeds. It also boasts the world's richest deposits of uranium and potash, used in fertilizer, and produces oil and natural gas. Regina, the capital, is home to the training academy of the Royal Canadian Mounted Police. Saskatoon, the largest city, is the headquarters of the mining industry and an important educational, research and technology centre.
亞伯達（Alberta）是人口最多的草原省份。這個省和洛磯山脈中舉世聞名的露易絲湖，都是以維多利亞女王的第四個女兒露易絲・卡洛琳・亞伯達公主命名的。亞伯達有五個國家公園，包括 1885 年設立的班夫國家公園。崎嶇的惡地藏有世界上最豐富的史前化石和恐龍發現。亞伯達是最大的石油和天然氣生產地，北部的油砂正被開發為主要能源。亞伯達也以農業聞名，尤其是廣大的牧牛場，使加拿大成為世界主要牛肉生產國之一。
Alberta is the most populous Prairie province. The province, and the world-famous Lake Louise in the Rocky Mountains, were both named after Princess Louise Caroline Alberta, fourth daughter of Queen Victoria. Alberta has five national parks, including Banff National Park, established in 1885. The rugged Badlands house some of the world's richest deposits of prehistoric fossils and dinosaur finds. Alberta is the largest producer of oil and gas, and the oil sands in the north are being developed as a major energy source. Alberta is also renowned for agriculture, especially for the vast cattle ranches that make Canada one of the world's major beef producers.

西海岸The West Coast

卑詩省以雄偉的山脈聞名，也是加拿大通往太平洋的門戶。溫哥華港是加拿大最大、最繁忙的港口，處理價值數十億美元、與世界各地交易的貨物。來自太平洋的暖氣流讓卑詩省海岸有溫和的氣候。
British Columbia is known for its majestic mountains and as Canada's Pacific gateway. The Port of Vancouver, Canada's largest and busiest, handles billions of dollars in goods traded around the world. Warm airstreams from the Pacific Ocean give the B.C. coast a temperate climate.
位於太平洋岸的卑詩省（British Columbia，B.C.）是加拿大最西邊的省，人口四百萬。溫哥華港是我們通往亞太地區的門戶。卑詩省生產的商品約有一半是林產品，包括木材、新聞紙、紙漿和紙製品——是加拿大最有價值的林業。卑詩省也以礦業、漁業，以及奧卡納根谷的果園和葡萄酒產業聞名。卑詩省擁有加拿大最龐大的公園系統，約有 600 個省立公園。這個省龐大的亞裔社群，使中文和旁遮普語成為城市裡僅次於英語最常使用的語言。首府維多利亞（Victoria）是旅遊中心，也是海軍太平洋艦隊的總部。
British Columbia (B.C.), on the Pacific coast, is Canada's westernmost province, with a population of four million. The Port of Vancouver is our gateway to the Asia-Pacific. About one-half of all the goods produced in B.C. are forestry products, including lumber, newsprint, and pulp and paper products—the most valuable forestry industry in Canada. B.C. is also known for mining, fishing, and the fruit orchards and wine industry of the Okanagan Valley. B.C. has the most extensive park system in Canada, with approximately 600 provincial parks. The province's large Asian communities have made Chinese and Punjabi the most spoken languages in the cities after English. The capital, Victoria, is a tourist centre and headquarters of the navy's Pacific fleet.

北方地區The Northern Territories

西北地區、努納福特和育空占加拿大三分之一的陸地面積，但人口只有十萬。這裡有金礦、鉛礦、銅礦、鑽石礦和鋅礦。石油和天然氣礦藏正在開發中。北方常被稱為「午夜太陽之地」，因為在盛夏，白晝可長達 24 小時。冬天，太陽消失，黑暗持續三個月。北方地區冬天漫長寒冷，夏天短暫涼爽。北方大部分是凍原，也就是廣闊多岩石的北極平原。由於北極的寒冷氣候，凍原上沒有樹木，土壤永久凍結。有些人仍靠狩獵、捕魚和設陷阱捕獸維生。因紐特藝術品銷售到全加拿大和世界各地。
The Northwest Territories, Nunavut and Yukon contain one-third of Canada's land mass but have a population of only 100,000. There are gold, lead, copper, diamond and zinc mines. Oil and gas deposits are being developed. The North is often referred to as the "Land of the Midnight Sun" because at the height of summer, daylight can last up to 24 hours. In winter, the sun disappears and darkness sets in for three months. The Northern territories have long cold winters and short cool summers. Much of the North is made up of tundra, the vast rocky Arctic plain. Because of the cold Arctic climate, there are no trees on the tundra and the soil is permanently frozen. Some continue to earn a living by hunting, fishing and trapping. Inuit art is sold throughout Canada and around the world.
西北地區（Northwest Territories，N.W.T.）最初在 1870 年由魯珀特地和西北領地組成。首府黃刀鎮（Yellowknife，人口兩萬）被稱為「北美鑽石之都」。超過一半的人口是原住民（迪尼族、因紐特人和梅蒂人）。馬更些河（Mackenzie River）長 4,200 公里，是北美僅次於密西西比河的第二長河流系統，流域面積 180 萬平方公里。
The Northwest Territories (N.W.T.) were originally made up in 1870 from Rupert's Land and the North-Western Territory. The capital, Yellowknife (population 20,000), is called the "diamond capital of North America." More than half the population is Aboriginal (Dene, Inuit and Métis). The Mackenzie River, at 4,200 kilometres, is the second-longest river system in North America after the Mississippi and drains an area of 1.8 million square kilometres.
1890 年代淘金熱期間，成千上萬的礦工來到育空（Yukon），詩人羅伯特・W・瑟維斯（Robert W. Service）的詩歌歌頌了這段歷史。礦業仍然是經濟的重要部分。白隘口與育空鐵路於 1900 年通車，從鄰近阿拉斯加的史凱威到地區首府白馬市（Whitehorse），提供穿越險峻山口和橋梁的壯觀觀光行程。育空保有加拿大有記錄以來最低溫的紀錄（攝氏零下 63 度）。位於育空的洛根山（Mount Logan）是加拿大最高的山。它以世界著名地質學家威廉・洛根爵士（Sir William Logan）命名；他 1798 年生於蒙特婁，父母是蘇格蘭移民，1842 年到 1869 年創立並領導加拿大地質調查局，被視為加拿大最偉大的科學家之一。
Thousands of miners came to the Yukon during the Gold Rush of the 1890s, as celebrated in the poetry of Robert W. Service. Mining remains a significant part of the economy. The White Pass and Yukon Railway opened from Skagway in neighbouring Alaska to the territorial capital, Whitehorse, in 1900 and provides a spectacular tourist excursion across precipitous passes and bridges. Yukon holds the record for the coldest temperature ever recorded in Canada (-63°C). Mount Logan, located in the Yukon, is the highest mountain in Canada. It is named in honour of Sir William Logan, a world-famous geologist, born in Montreal in 1798 to Scottish immigrant parents, who founded and directed the Geological Survey of Canada from 1842 to 1869 and is considered one of Canada's greatest scientists.
努納福特（Nunavut）在因紐特語中意為「我們的土地」，於 1999 年從西北地區的東部設立，包括原來的整個基瓦丁區。首府是伊魁特（Iqaluit），舊稱弗羅比舍灣，以英國探險家馬丁・弗羅比舍命名；他在 1576 年為伊莉莎白一世女王深入未知的北極。由 19 名議員組成的立法議會以共識方式選出省長和部長。人口約 85% 是因紐特人，因紐特語是官方語言，也是學校的第一語言。
Nunavut, meaning "our land" in Inuktitut, was established in 1999 from the eastern part of the Northwest Territories, including all of the former District of Keewatin. The capital is Iqaluit, formerly Frobisher Bay, named after the English explorer Martin Frobisher, who penetrated the uncharted Arctic for Queen Elizabeth I in 1576. The 19-member Legislative Assembly chooses a premier and ministers by consensus. The population is about 85% Inuit, and Inuktitut is an official language and the first language in schools.

加拿大巡邏隊The Canadian Rangers

加拿大廣闊的北方帶來安全與主權的挑戰。在偏遠地區面對嚴酷天氣，加拿大巡邏隊（Canadian Rangers）——加拿大軍隊後備部隊（民兵）的一部分——扮演關鍵角色。巡邏隊運用原住民的知識和經驗，冬天騎雪上摩托車、夏天駕駛全地形車，從雷索盧特一直巡邏到磁北極，讓國旗在加拿大的北極飄揚。
Canada's vast North brings security and sovereignty challenges. Dealing with harsh weather conditions in an isolated region, the Canadian Rangers, part of the Canadian Forces Reserves (militia), play a key role. Drawing on indigenous knowledge and experience, the Rangers travel by snowmobile in the winter and all-terrain vehicles in the summer from Resolute to the Magnetic North Pole, and keep the flag flying in Canada's Arctic.

🎧 12 官方練習題與解答 Study Questions with Answers

左中文、右英文，句對句對照。按段落左邊的 ▶ 朗讀該段；點中文任一句從那句開始念；念到哪一句，中英文同時標黃。點任何一個英文字會跳出字典卡並用慢速念這個字。空白鍵＝暫停／繼續。

釋義來源：ECDICT 開源字典＋加拿大語境補充。點其他地方或按 Esc 關閉。

關於考試About the test

公民身分的基本要求之一，是證明你對加拿大有足夠的了解。公民考試用來評估你對加拿大以及身為加拿大公民的權利與責任的了解。所有公民考試的題目都根據這本學習指南提供的資訊出題。下面的題目和公民考試中的題目類似。所有答案都可以在這本學習指南裡找到。真正的考試有 20 題選擇或是非題，英文或法文，30 分鐘，答對 15 題就通過。
One of the basic requirements of citizenship is to demonstrate that you have adequate knowledge of Canada. The citizenship test is used to assess your knowledge of Canada and the rights and responsibilities of being a citizen in Canada. All the citizenship test questions are based on information provided in this study guide. The questions below are similar to the questions that are found on the citizenship test. All the answers can be found in this study guide. The real test has 20 multiple-choice or true-false questions in English or French, 30 minutes, and you pass with 15 correct answers.

官方選擇題範例Official sample questions (multiple choice)

第 1 題。公民的三項責任是什麼？a）效忠加拿大、回收報紙、在海軍、陸軍或空軍服役。b）遵守法律、為自己和家人負責、擔任陪審員。c）學習兩種官方語言、在選舉中投票、加入工會。d）購買加拿大產品、擁有自己的事業、少用水。答：b。書中列的六項責任是：遵守法律、為自己和家人負責、擔任陪審員、在選舉中投票、幫助社區裡的他人、保護我們的遺產與環境。（第 2 章）
Question 1. What are three responsibilities of citizenship? a) Being loyal to Canada, recycling newspapers, serving in the navy, army or air force. b) Obeying the law, taking responsibility for oneself and one's family, serving on a jury. c) Learning both official languages, voting in elections, belonging to a union. d) Buying Canadian products, owning your own business, using less water. Answer: b. The six responsibilities in the guide are obeying the law, taking responsibility for oneself and one's family, serving on a jury, voting in elections, helping others in the community, and protecting our heritage and environment. (Chapter 2)
第 2 題。國殤紀念日的罌粟花有什麼意義？a）紀念我們的君主伊莉莎白二世女王。b）慶祝聯邦成立。c）向已故的總理致敬。d）紀念至今在戰爭中服役或犧牲的加拿大人。答：d。加拿大人佩戴紅色罌粟花，在 11 月 11 日上午 11 時默哀，向服役者以及十一萬名獻出生命的人致敬。（第 4 章）
Question 2. What is the meaning of the Remembrance Day poppy? a) To remember our Sovereign, Queen Elizabeth II. b) To celebrate Confederation. c) To honour prime ministers who have died. d) To remember the sacrifice of Canadians who have served or died in wars up to the present day. Answer: d. Canadians wear the red poppy and observe a moment of silence at 11 a.m. on November 11 to honour those who served and the 110,000 who gave their lives. (Chapter 4)
第 3 題。國會議員是怎麼產生的？a）由聯合國任命。b）由各省省長挑選。c）由他們所在選區的選民選出。d）由地主和警察局長選出。答：c。每個選區的公民選出一位國會議員到眾議院代表他們；得票最多的候選人當選。（第 7 章）
Question 3. How are members of Parliament chosen? a) They are appointed by the United Nations. b) They are chosen by the provincial premiers. c) They are elected by voters in their local constituency (riding). d) They are elected by landowners and police chiefs. Answer: c. The citizens in each electoral district, or riding, elect one MP to represent them in the House of Commons; the candidate with the most votes wins. (Chapter 7)

權利與責任Rights and responsibilities

第 4 題。說出兩份包含我們權利與自由的重要文件。答：1215 年的《大憲章》（又稱《自由大憲章》），以及 1982 年寫入憲法的《加拿大權利與自由憲章》。（第 2 章）
Question 4. Name two key documents that contain our rights and freedoms. Answer: The Magna Carta of 1215, also called the Great Charter of Freedoms, and the Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms, which was entrenched in the Constitution in 1982. (Chapter 2)
第 5 題。指出加拿大人享有的四項權利。答：遷徙權、原住民權利、官方語言權利與少數語言教育權利，以及多元文化。（第 2 章）
Question 5. Identify four rights that Canadians enjoy. Answer: Mobility rights, Aboriginal peoples' rights, official language rights and minority language educational rights, and multiculturalism. (Chapter 2)
第 6 題。說出加拿大人享有的四項基本自由。答：良心與宗教自由；思想、信仰、意見與表達的自由，包括言論自由和新聞自由；和平集會的自由；以及結社的自由。（第 2 章）
Question 6. Name four fundamental freedoms that Canadians enjoy. Answer: Freedom of conscience and religion; freedom of thought, belief, opinion and expression, including freedom of speech and of the press; freedom of peaceful assembly; and freedom of association. (Chapter 2)
第 7 題。「男女平等」是什麼意思？答：在加拿大，男女在法律之下一律平等。加拿大不容忍配偶虐待、榮譽殺人、女性割禮、強迫婚姻或其他性別暴力；犯下這些罪行的人會受到嚴厲懲罰。（第 2 章）
Question 7. What is meant by the equality of women and men? Answer: In Canada, men and women are equal under the law. Canada does not tolerate spousal abuse, honour killings, female genital mutilation, forced marriage or other gender-based violence; those guilty of these crimes are severely punished. (Chapter 2)
第 8 題。「為自己和家人負責」有哪些例子？答：找工作、照顧家人、盡自己的能力努力工作。工作有助於個人的尊嚴，也有助於加拿大的繁榮。（第 2 章）
Question 8. What are some examples of taking responsibility for yourself and your family? Answer: Getting a job, taking care of one's family, and working hard in keeping with one's abilities. Work contributes to personal dignity and to Canada's prosperity. (Chapter 2)

我們是誰與歷史Who we are and our history

第 9 題。加拿大的奠基民族是誰？答：三個奠基民族是原住民、法裔和英裔。（第 3 章）
Question 9. Who were the founding peoples of Canada? Answer: The three founding peoples are Aboriginal, French and British. (Chapter 3)
第 10 題。梅蒂人是誰？答：梅蒂人是原住民與歐洲人混血的獨特民族。大多數住在草原省份，有法語和英語兩種背景，並說自己的方言米奇夫語。（第 3 章）
Question 10. Who are the Métis? Answer: The Métis are a distinct people of mixed Aboriginal and European ancestry. Most live in the Prairie provinces, they come from both French- and English-speaking backgrounds, and they speak their own dialect, Michif. (Chapter 3)
第 11 題。「Inuit」這個詞是什麼意思？答：「Inuit」在因紐特語中的意思是「人」。因紐特人住在北極各地零星分散的小社區。（第 3 章）
Question 11. What does the word "Inuit" mean? Answer: "Inuit" means "the people" in the Inuktitut language. The Inuit live in small, scattered communities across the Arctic. (Chapter 3)
第 12 題。「責任政府」這個詞是什麼意思？答：王室的大臣們必須得到多數民選代表的支持才能執政。政府如果在議會的信任投票中落敗，就必須辭職。（第 4 章）
Question 12. What is meant by the term "responsible government"? Answer: The ministers of the Crown must have the support of a majority of the elected representatives in order to govern. If the government loses a confidence vote in the assembly, it must resign. (Chapter 4)
第 13 題。路易－伊波利特・拉方丹爵士是誰？答：民主與法語權利的捍衛者，也是 1849 年加拿大第一位責任政府的領袖。（第 4 章）
Question 13. Who was Sir Louis-Hippolyte La Fontaine? Answer: A champion of democracy and French language rights, and the first leader of a responsible government in the Canadas, in 1849. (Chapter 4)
第 14 題。加拿大太平洋鐵路象徵什麼？答：國家統一的有力象徵。1885 年 11 月 7 日敲下最後一根道釘時，鐵路把加拿大從海到海連接起來，實現了一個國家的夢想。（第 4 章）
Question 14. What did the Canadian Pacific Railway symbolize? Answer: A powerful symbol of unity. When the last spike was driven on November 7, 1885, the railway linked Canada from sea to sea and fulfilled a national dream. (Chapter 4)
第 15 題。「聯邦」（Confederation）是什麼意思？答：新斯科細亞、新布藍瑞克和加拿大省（拆成安大略與魁北克）在 1867 年 7 月 1 日聯合組成一個新國家「加拿大自治領」，設有聯邦和省兩級政府。（第 4 章）
Question 15. What does Confederation mean? Answer: The joining of Nova Scotia, New Brunswick and the Province of Canada, which became Ontario and Quebec, into one new country, the Dominion of Canada, on July 1, 1867, with two levels of government, federal and provincial. (Chapter 4)
第 16 題。弗雷德里克・班廷爵士和查爾斯・貝斯特發現胰島素有什麼重要意義？答：胰島素是治療糖尿病的荷爾蒙，他們的發現在全世界拯救了一千六百萬條生命。（第 5 章）
Question 16. What is the significance of the discovery of insulin by Sir Frederick Banting and Charles Best? Answer: Insulin is a hormone to treat diabetes, and their discovery has saved 16 million lives worldwide. (Chapter 5)

政府與選舉Government and elections

第 17 題。說加拿大是「君主立憲國」是什麼意思？答：加拿大的國家元首是世襲的君主（國王或女王），依據憲法——也就是法治——統治。君主在加拿大由總督代表，而總理作為政府首長，實際指揮國家的治理。（第 6 章）
Question 17. What does it mean to say that Canada is a constitutional monarchy? Answer: Canada's Head of State is a hereditary Sovereign, the King or Queen, who reigns in accordance with the Constitution, that is, the rule of law. The Sovereign is represented in Canada by the Governor General, while the Prime Minister, as head of government, actually directs the governing of the country. (Chapter 6)
第 18 題。政府的三個部門是什麼？答：行政、立法和司法三個部門。它們既合作又時有良性的張力，以保障加拿大人的權利與自由。（第 6 章）
Question 18. What are the three branches of government? Answer: The Executive, the Legislative and the Judicial branches. They work together, but sometimes in creative tension, to secure the rights and freedoms of Canadians. (Chapter 6)
第 19 題。女王的角色和總理的角色有什麼不同？答：君主是國家元首，是超越黨派的加拿大主權象徵，也是公民身分與效忠的核心。總理是政府首長，實際指揮國家的治理。（第 6 章）
Question 19. What is the difference between the role of the Queen and that of the Prime Minister? Answer: The Sovereign is the head of state, a non-partisan symbol of Canadian sovereignty and the focus of citizenship and allegiance. The Prime Minister is the head of government, who actually directs the governing of the country. (Chapter 6)
第 20 題。加拿大人能獲得的最高榮譽是什麼？答：維多利亞十字勳章，頒給在敵人面前表現最卓越勇敢的人。自 1854 年以來已有 96 位加拿大人獲頒。（第 9 章）
Question 20. What is the highest honour that Canadians can receive? Answer: The Victoria Cross, awarded for the most conspicuous bravery in the presence of the enemy. It has been awarded to 96 Canadians since 1854. (Chapter 9)
第 21 題。選舉日去投票時，你要做什麼？答：帶著選民資訊卡以及身分和地址證明，到卡上列出的投票站。到遮板後面，在你選擇的候選人姓名旁邊的圓圈裡畫一個 X，把選票摺起來交給工作人員；工作人員撕下選票編號後交還給你，由你投進投票箱。（第 7 章）
Question 21. When you go to vote on election day, what do you do? Answer: Go to the polling station listed on your voter information card, bringing the card and proof of your identity and address. Go behind the screen, mark an X in the circle next to the candidate of your choice, fold the ballot and present it to the poll officials, who tear off the ballot number and give it back to you to deposit in the ballot box. (Chapter 7)
第 22 題。誰有資格在加拿大聯邦選舉中投票？答：投票日當天年滿 18 歲、並且在選民名冊上的加拿大公民。（第 7 章）
Question 22. Who is entitled to vote in Canadian federal elections? Answer: A Canadian citizen who is at least 18 years old on voting day and is on the voters' list. (Chapter 7)
第 23 題。在加拿大，你有義務告訴別人你投給了誰嗎？答：沒有。加拿大法律保障不記名投票的權利。沒有人——包括家人、雇主或工會代表——有權堅持要你告訴他們你投給了誰。（第 7 章）
Question 23. In Canada, are you obliged to tell other people how you voted? Answer: No. Canadian law secures the right to a secret ballot. No one, including family members, your employer or a union representative, has the right to insist that you tell them how you voted. (Chapter 7)
第 24 題。選舉之後，哪個政黨組成政府？答：在眾議院席次最多的政黨。總督邀請該黨領袖組成政府，該領袖成為總理。席次達一半以上是多數政府，不到一半是少數政府。（第 7 章）
Question 24. After an election, which party forms the government? Answer: The party with the most seats in the House of Commons. Its leader is invited by the Governor General to form the government and becomes the Prime Minister. With at least half the seats it is a majority government; with fewer, a minority government. (Chapter 7)
第 25 題。你的國會議員是誰？答：這要看你住在哪裡。到 elections.ca 輸入郵遞區號，查出你的聯邦選區和國會議員，把名字寫下來背熟。安大略省題也要一併確認現任省長和省督。（第 7 章）
Question 25. Who is your member of Parliament? Answer: This depends on where you live. Find your federal riding and its MP by entering your postal code at elections.ca, then write the name down and memorize it. For the Ontario questions, also check the current Premier and Lieutenant Governor. (Chapter 7)
第 26 題。三級政府是哪三級？答：聯邦、省或地區，以及市鎮（地方）。（第 6 章）
Question 26. What are the three levels of government? Answer: Federal, provincial or territorial, and municipal (local). (Chapter 6)

司法、象徵與地區Justice, symbols and regions

第 27 題。法院在加拿大的角色是什麼？答：法院解決糾紛，警察執行法律。加拿大最高法院是最高的法院。（第 8 章）
Question 27. What is the role of the courts in Canada? Answer: The courts settle disputes, while the police enforce the laws. The Supreme Court of Canada is the highest court. (Chapter 8)
第 28 題。在加拿大，你可以質疑警察的服務或行為嗎？答：可以。你可以就警察的服務或行為提出質疑，幾乎所有警察機關都有程序讓你反映疑慮並要求處理。（第 8 章）
Question 28. In Canada, are you allowed to question the police about their service or conduct? Answer: Yes. You can question the police about their service or conduct, and almost all police forces have a process by which you can bring your concerns to them and seek action. (Chapter 8)
第 29 題。說出兩個加拿大的象徵。答：例如楓葉和海狸。其他還有加拿大國旗、王權、國徽、國會大廈、國歌《噢！加拿大》，以及皇家加拿大騎警。（第 9 章）
Question 29. Name two Canadian symbols. Answer: For example, the maple leaf and the beaver. Others include the Canadian flag, the Crown, the coat of arms, the Parliament buildings, the national anthem O Canada, and the RCMP. (Chapter 9)
第 30 題。哪些省被稱為大西洋省份？答：紐芬蘭與拉布拉多、愛德華王子島、新斯科細亞和新布藍瑞克。（第 11 章）
Question 30. What provinces are referred to as the Atlantic Provinces? Answer: Newfoundland and Labrador, Prince Edward Island, Nova Scotia and New Brunswick. (Chapter 11)
第 31 題。你居住的省或地區的首府是哪裡？答：安大略的首府是多倫多。加拿大的首都是渥太華。（第 11 章）
Question 31. What is the capital of the province or territory that you live in? Answer: For Ontario, the capital is Toronto. The capital of Canada is Ottawa. (Chapter 11)

🎧 220 題中英問答題庫 220 Review Questions with Answers

左中文、右英文，句對句對照。按段落左邊的 ▶ 朗讀該段；點中文任一句從那句開始念；念到哪一句，中英文同時標黃。點任何一個英文字會跳出字典卡並用慢速念這個字。空白鍵＝暫停／繼續。

釋義來源：ECDICT 開源字典＋加拿大語境補充。點其他地方或按 Esc 關閉。

第 1 部分 — 公民、權利、責任（25 題）Chapter 1 — Citizenship, Rights and Responsibilities (25)

1. 加拿大入籍誓詞中效忠的對象是？答：加拿大國王查理三世，及其繼承人與後嗣。
1. To whom do you swear allegiance in the Oath of Citizenship? Answer: King Charles the Third, King of Canada, his heirs and successors.
2. 入籍誓詞特別承認哪三類原住民條約權利？答：第一民族、因紐特人、梅蒂人。
2. Which three Aboriginal peoples' treaty rights does the Oath specifically recognize? Answer: First Nations, Inuit and Métis.
3. 公民的 4 大基本自由依憲章是？答：良知／宗教自由；思想、信仰、意見與表達自由（含新聞）；和平集會自由；結社自由。
3. What are the four fundamental freedoms in the Charter? Answer: Freedom of conscience and religion; freedom of thought, belief, opinion and expression (including the press); freedom of peaceful assembly; freedom of association.
4. 公民的 6 大責任？答：守法、照顧自己與家庭、擔任陪審員、投票、協助社區、保護加拿大遺產與環境。
4. What are the six responsibilities of citizenship? Answer: Obeying the law, taking responsibility for oneself and one's family, serving on a jury, voting in elections, helping others in the community, and protecting and enjoying our heritage and environment.
5. 「Mobility Rights」指什麼？答：在加拿大任意居住、工作、自由進出國境並申請護照的權利。
5. What are Mobility Rights? Answer: The right to live and work anywhere in Canada, to enter and leave the country freely, and to apply for a passport.
6. 「Habeas Corpus」是什麼權利？答：被拘留者可挑戰拘留合法性的權利；來自英國普通法。
6. What right is habeas corpus? Answer: The right to challenge unlawful detention by the state; it comes from English common law.
7. 公民有沒有不工作的權利？答：沒有此項保障，但也不強迫做特定工作。找工作、努力工作被視為責任與加拿大價值。
7. Do citizens have a right not to work? Answer: There is no such guarantee, but no one is forced into a particular job. Getting a job and working hard is described as a responsibility and a Canadian value.
8. 加拿大男女在法律上是否平等？答：是。
8. Are men and women equal under Canadian law? Answer: Yes.
9. 強迫婚姻在加拿大是民事還是刑事？答：刑事——犯者依加拿大刑法嚴懲。
9. Is forced marriage a civil or a criminal matter in Canada? Answer: Criminal — those guilty are severely punished under Canada's criminal laws.
10. 加拿大 1982 年的最重要法律文件是什麼？答：《加拿大權利與自由憲章》，1982 年寫入憲法。
10. What is Canada's most important legal document of 1982? Answer: The Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms, entrenched in the Constitution in 1982.
11. Magna Carta 是哪一年的英國文件？答：1215 年。
11. In what year was Magna Carta signed in England? Answer: 1215.
12. 服務陪審團屬權利還是責任？答：責任——被傳喚時依法必須擔任。
12. Is serving on a jury a right or a responsibility? Answer: A responsibility — when called, you are legally required to serve.
13. 投票屬權利還是責任？答：兩者皆是——投票權伴隨投票的責任。
13. Is voting a right or a responsibility? Answer: Both — the right to vote comes with the responsibility to vote.
14. 永久居民可不可以投票？答：不可以——只有 18 歲以上且在選民名冊上的加拿大公民可以。
14. Can permanent residents vote in federal elections? Answer: No — only Canadian citizens aged 18 or older on the voters' list.
15. 加拿大法律來自哪三大傳統？答：英國不成文憲政、英國普通法、法國民法，加上國會與各省通過的法律。
15. What are the three traditions that Canadian law comes from? Answer: The unwritten British constitution, English common law, and the civil code of France, plus laws passed by Parliament and the provinces.
16. 「Rule of Law」是什麼意思？答：政府與人民都受法律約束，沒有人凌駕於法律之上。
16. What does the rule of law mean? Answer: Both government and people are bound by the law; no person or group is above the law.
17. 言論自由是否包含新聞自由？答：是——表達自由包含言論自由與新聞自由。
17. Does freedom of expression include freedom of the press? Answer: Yes — freedom of thought, belief, opinion and expression includes freedom of speech and of the press.
18. 多元文化遺產屬於權利還是責任？答：權利——憲章把多元文化列為加拿大傳統與身分的基本特徵。
18. Is multiculturalism a right or a responsibility? Answer: A right — the Charter lists multiculturalism as a fundamental characteristic of Canadian heritage and identity.
19. 守法屬於權利還是責任？答：責任。
19. Is obeying the law a right or a responsibility? Answer: A responsibility.
20. 你不可以做以下哪一項：（A）信仰自選（B）公開集會（C）拒絕守法（D）和平結社答：C——守法是每位公民的責任。
20. Which of these may you NOT do: (A) choose your religion, (B) assemble publicly, (C) refuse to obey the law, (D) associate peacefully? Answer: C — obeying the law is a responsibility of every citizen.
21. 「Equality before the law」中文是？答：法律之前人人平等。
21. What is 'equality before the law' in Chinese? Answer: Everyone is equal before the law.
22. 公民與永久居民的最大差別之一是什麼？答：投票權、競選公職、持加拿大護照。
22. What is one of the biggest differences between a citizen and a permanent resident? Answer: Citizens can vote, run for office and hold a Canadian passport.
23. 「協助社區」是公民責任嗎？答：是——數百萬志工無償幫助他人。
23. Is helping others in the community a responsibility of citizenship? Answer: Yes — millions of volunteers help others without pay.
24. 「保護加拿大遺產與環境」是責任還是權利？答：責任。
24. Is protecting Canada's heritage and environment a responsibility or a right? Answer: A responsibility.
25. 申請入籍時誓詞中說的「Constitution」包含哪一份文件？答：《加拿大權利與自由憲章》，其中承認並確認原住民與條約權利。
25. Which document does 'the Constitution' in the Oath include? Answer: The Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms, which recognizes and affirms Aboriginal and treaty rights.

第 2 部分 — 我們是誰、語言、原住民（20 題）Chapter 2 — Who We Are, Languages, Aboriginal Peoples (20)

1. 加拿大三大開國民族？答：原住民、法裔、英裔。
1. Who are Canada's three founding peoples? Answer: Aboriginal, French and British.
2. 原住民 3 大類別與占原住民人口比例？答：第一民族約 65%、梅蒂人 30%、因紐特人 4%。
2. What are the three groups of Aboriginal peoples and their share of the Aboriginal population? Answer: First Nations about 65%, Métis 30%, Inuit 4%.
3. 哪一族原住民住在北極區？答：因紐特人。
3. Which Aboriginal people live in the Arctic? Answer: The Inuit.
4. 哪一族原住民是歐裔與原住民混血？答：梅蒂人。
4. Which Aboriginal people are of mixed Aboriginal and European ancestry? Answer: The Métis.
5. 兩種官方語言？答：英語與法語。
5. What are the two official languages? Answer: English and French.
6. 官方語言法哪一年通過？答：1969 年。
6. In what year was the Official Languages Act passed? Answer: 1969.
7. 多元文化主義哪一年成為加拿大官方政策？答：1971 年。
7. In what year did multiculturalism become official policy? Answer: 1971.
8. 推動多元文化主義的總理是？答：皮埃爾・艾略特・杜魯道（老杜魯道）。
8. Which prime minister introduced multiculturalism? Answer: Pierre Elliott Trudeau.
9. 加拿大最大宗教傳統是？答：基督宗教——天主教最多，其次是新教。
9. What is the largest religious tradition in Canada? Answer: Christianity — Catholics are the largest group, followed by Protestants.
10. 加拿大目前人口大約多少？答：約 4,000 萬（2021 年版指南寫約 3,400 萬）。
10. What is Canada's population today? Answer: About 40 million (the 2021 guide says about 34 million).
11. 三大都會是？答：多倫多、蒙特婁、溫哥華。
11. What are Canada's three largest metropolitan areas? Answer: Toronto, Montreal and Vancouver.
12. 法裔人口大約多少？答：約 700 萬以法語為第一語言，多數住魁北克。
12. How many Francophones are there? Answer: About seven million speak French as their first language; most live in Quebec.
13. 哪個省以法文為唯一官方語言？答：魁北克。
13. Which province has French as its only official language? Answer: Quebec.
14. Acadians 是指什麼人？答：1604 年起在濱海省份定居的法國殖民者後代。
14. Who are the Acadians? Answer: Descendants of French colonists who began settling in the Maritimes in 1604.
15. Quebecers 是指什麼人？答：魁北克的居民，絕大多數說法語。
15. Who are Quebecers? Answer: The people of Quebec, the vast majority French-speaking.
16. 「Residential Schools」是什麼？答：聯邦政府強制原住民兒童入住、禁止母語與傳統文化、以同化為目的的學校，許多學生受苦。
16. What were residential schools? Answer: Schools where the federal government placed Aboriginal children to assimilate them; languages and culture were mostly prohibited and many students suffered.
17. 加拿大政府哪一年正式為寄宿學校道歉？由誰代表？答：2008 年；總理史蒂芬・哈珀。
17. When did the government apologize for residential schools, and who spoke? Answer: 2008; Prime Minister Stephen Harper.
18. 80% 的加拿大人住城市還是鄉村？答：城市。
18. Do most Canadians live in cities or rural areas? Answer: Cities — the majority live in urban areas.
19. 與原住民簽訂條約最早從哪一年開始？答：1763 年《皇家公告》奠定了條約談判的基礎。
19. When were treaties with Aboriginal peoples first guaranteed? Answer: The Royal Proclamation of 1763 established the basis for negotiating treaties.
20. 加拿大尊重宗教自由嗎？答：是——良知與宗教自由是基本自由。
20. Does Canada respect religious freedom? Answer: Yes — freedom of conscience and religion is a fundamental freedom.

第 3 部分 — 歷史（45 題）Chapter 3 — History (45)

1. 「Canada」一詞來自哪族語言？意思？答：易洛魁語——kanata 意為「村莊」。
1. Which language does the word 'Canada' come from, and what does it mean? Answer: Iroquoian — kanata means 'village'.
2. 第一批抵達北美的歐洲人是哪族？地點？年代？答：維京人；紐芬蘭的蘭塞奧茲牧草地；約一千年前。
2. Who were the first Europeans to reach North America, where, and when? Answer: The Vikings; L'Anse aux Meadows, Newfoundland; about 1,000 years ago.
3. 1497 探勘加拿大東岸的義裔英國探險家？答：約翰・卡伯特。
3. Which Italian explorer sailing for England mapped Canada's East Coast in 1497? Answer: John Cabot.
4. 1534/1535 探勘 St. Lawrence Gulf 的法國人？答：雅克・卡蒂亞。
4. Which Frenchman explored the Gulf of St. Lawrence in 1534–35? Answer: Jacques Cartier.
5. 1608 建立 Quebec City 者？被稱什麼？答：薩繆爾・德・尚普蘭；新法蘭西之父。
5. Who founded Quebec City in 1608, and what is he called? Answer: Samuel de Champlain; the Father of New France.
6. 1670 成立的最大殖民貿易公司？由哪位英王授權？答：哈德遜灣公司；英王查理二世。
6. Which great trading company was chartered in 1670, and by which king? Answer: The Hudson's Bay Company; King Charles II.
7. 哈德遜灣公司的領地稱為？答：魯珀特地。
7. What was the Hudson's Bay Company's territory called? Answer: Rupert's Land.
8. 1759 戰役名稱與地點？答：亞伯拉罕平原戰役，魁北克市城外。
8. What was the battle of 1759, and where? Answer: The Battle of the Plains of Abraham, outside Quebec City.
9. 1759 英法兩將軍是誰？結果？答：沃爾夫（英）與蒙卡姆（法）；雙雙陣亡，英軍勝。
9. Who were the two commanders in 1759, and what was the result? Answer: Wolfe (British) and Montcalm (French); both were killed and the British won.
10. 1763 法國割讓加拿大的條約？答：1763 年《巴黎條約》。
10. By which treaty did France cede Canada in 1763? Answer: The Treaty of Paris, 1763.
11. 1774《Quebec Act》保留法裔哪三項權利？答：天主教信仰自由、擔任公職的權利、法國民法。
11. Which three rights did the Quebec Act of 1774 preserve for French Canadians? Answer: Religious freedom for Catholics, the right to hold public office, and French civil law.
12. 1775–83 北逃加拿大的英裔保皇黨稱？答：效忠派／聯合帝國效忠派。
12. What were the British loyalists who fled north in 1775–83 called? Answer: Loyalists, or United Empire Loyalists.
13. Loyalists 大致逃了多少人？答：超過四萬人。
13. Roughly how many Loyalists fled to Canada? Answer: More than 40,000.
14. 1812 戰爭加拿大對抗哪國？答：美國。
14. Which country did Canada fight in the War of 1812? Answer: The United States.
15. 1812「Saviour of Upper Canada」是誰？答：少將艾薩克・布洛克爵士。
15. Who was the 'Saviour of Upper Canada' in 1812? Answer: Major-General Sir Isaac Brock.
16. 1812 與英軍結盟的原住民首領是？答：酋長特庫姆塞。
16. Which First Nations chief allied with the British in 1812? Answer: Chief Tecumseh.
17. Laura Secord 做了什麼事？答：步行 30 公里向英軍通報美軍進攻，促成比佛丹戰役勝利。
17. What did Laura Secord do? Answer: She walked 30 km to warn the British of an American attack, helping win the Battle of Beaver Dams.
18. 1813 美軍焚毀的城市？今天叫什麼？答：約克；今天的多倫多。
18. Which city did the Americans burn in 1813, and what is it called today? Answer: York; today Toronto.
19. 1814 英軍焚毀的建築是？答：華盛頓特區的白宮。
19. Which building did the British burn in 1814? Answer: The White House in Washington, D.C.
20. 1834 大英帝國通過什麼？答：全帝國廢除奴隸制度（1833 年）。
20. What did the British Empire do in 1833–34? Answer: It abolished slavery throughout the Empire (1833).
21. Underground Railroad 是什麼？答：協助美國黑奴秘密逃往加拿大的基督教反奴隸網絡。
21. What was the Underground Railroad? Answer: A Christian anti-slavery network that helped American slaves escape to Canada.
22. 1837–38 兩位叛亂領袖？答：威廉・萊昂・麥肯齊（上加拿大）與路易－約瑟夫・帕皮諾（下加拿大）。
22. Who were the two rebel leaders of 1837–38? Answer: William Lyon Mackenzie (Upper Canada) and Louis-Joseph Papineau (Lower Canada).
23. 1840 統一上下加拿大的法案？答：1840 年《聯合法案》。
23. Which Act united Upper and Lower Canada in 1840? Answer: The Act of Union, 1840.
24. 1848/49 達成責任政府的雙人組？答：羅伯特・鮑德溫與路易－伊波利特・拉方丹。
24. Which pair achieved responsible government in 1848–49? Answer: Robert Baldwin and Louis-Hippolyte La Fontaine.
25. 1867/7/1 邦聯誕生的法律文件名稱？答：1867 年《英屬北美法案》。
25. Which law created Confederation on July 1, 1867? Answer: The British North America Act, 1867.
26. 1867 建國 4 個省？答：安大略、魁北克、新斯科細亞、新布藍瑞克。
26. Which four provinces formed Canada in 1867? Answer: Ontario, Quebec, Nova Scotia and New Brunswick.
27. 加拿大首任總理？答：約翰・A・麥克唐納爵士。
27. Who was Canada's first prime minister? Answer: Sir John A. Macdonald.
28. Dominion 字源出自聖經？答：《詩篇》72 篇 8 節——「從這海直到那海」。
28. Where does the word 'Dominion' come from? Answer: Psalm 72:8 — 'dominion from sea to sea'.
29. 國徽箴言中文？答：從海到海。
29. What is Canada's motto in Chinese? Answer: A mari usque ad mare — from sea to sea.
30. Manitoba 與 NWT 加入年份？答：1870 年。
30. When did Manitoba and the Northwest Territories join? Answer: 1870.
31. BC 加入年份？答：1871 年。
31. When did British Columbia join? Answer: 1871.
32. PEI 加入年份？答：1873 年。
32. When did Prince Edward Island join? Answer: 1873.
33. Yukon 加入年份？答：1898 年。
33. When was Yukon Territory created? Answer: 1898.
34. Alberta、Saskatchewan 加入年份？答：1905 年。
34. When did Alberta and Saskatchewan join? Answer: 1905.
35. Newfoundland and Labrador 加入年份？答：1949 年。
35. When did Newfoundland and Labrador join? Answer: 1949.
36. Nunavut 成立年份？答：1999 年。
36. When was Nunavut created? Answer: 1999.
37. CPR 完工年份？答：1885 年。
37. When was the Canadian Pacific Railway completed? Answer: 1885.
38. CPR 多少華工參與？哪一年道歉？哪位總理？答：約 15,000 人；2006 年由總理史蒂芬・哈珀為人頭稅道歉。
38. How many Chinese workers built the CPR, and when and by whom was the apology made? Answer: About 15,000; the apology for the Head Tax came in 2006 from Prime Minister Stephen Harper.
39. Métis 領袖 Louis Riel 兩次抵抗年份？最終下場？答：1869–70 紅河；1885 西北叛亂；以叛國罪處絞。
39. When were Louis Riel's two uprisings, and what happened to him? Answer: Red River 1869–70 and the North-West Rebellion 1885; he was hanged for high treason.
40. 1916 首個給予婦女省級投票權的省？答：曼尼托巴。
40. Which province first gave women the provincial vote, in 1916? Answer: Manitoba.
41. 1921 首位女性 MP？答：艾格妮絲・麥克費爾。
41. Who was the first woman MP, in 1921? Answer: Agnes Macphail.
42. 1929 婦女被法律承認為「人」的案件名稱？答：「人格案」（Persons Case），由 Famous Five 打贏。
42. What was the 1929 case that recognized women as 'persons'? Answer: The Persons Case, won by the Famous Five.
43. WWI 加拿大服役/陣亡人數？答：超過 60 萬人服役；6 萬人陣亡。
43. How many Canadians served and died in the First World War? Answer: More than 600,000 served; 60,000 were killed.
44. 1917 加拿大民族認同誕生的戰役？答：維米嶺。
44. Which 1917 battle is seen as the birth of Canadian national identity? Answer: Vimy Ridge.
45. WWII 加拿大何時對德宣戰？陣亡人數約？D-Day 加軍負責灘頭？答：1939 年 9 月；約 44,000 人陣亡；朱諾海灘。
45. When did Canada declare war on Germany, how many died, and which D-Day beach did Canadians take? Answer: September 1939; about 44,000 killed; Juno Beach.

第 4 部分 — 現代加拿大（25 題）Chapter 4 — Modern Canada (25)

1. 加拿大何時加入 UN？答：1945 年。
1. When did Canada join the United Nations? Answer: 1945.
2. 加拿大何時加入 NATO？答：1949 年。
2. When did Canada join NATO? Answer: 1949.
3. 韓戰加拿大派兵多少？答：超過 26,000 人；500 人陣亡、1,000 人受傷。
3. How many Canadians served in the Korean War? Answer: More than 26,000; 500 died and 1,000 were wounded.
4. Lester Pearson 何時獲諾貝爾和平獎？答：1957 年。
4. When did Lester Pearson win the Nobel Peace Prize? Answer: 1957.
5. 因什麼貢獻獲獎？答：1956 年蘇伊士危機時提出聯合國維和部隊。
5. For what contribution did Pearson win the prize? Answer: Proposing the UN peacekeeping force during the 1956 Suez Crisis.
6. 國旗哪一年啟用？答：1965 年。
6. In what year was the current flag adopted? Answer: 1965.
7. 官方語言法哪一年？答：1969 年。
7. In what year was the Official Languages Act passed? Answer: 1969.
8. 多元文化哪一年成官方政策？答：1971 年。
8. In what year did multiculturalism become official policy? Answer: 1971.
9. 1982 憲法歸國誰簽署？答：伊莉莎白二世女王，在渥太華。
9. Who signed the patriated Constitution in 1982? Answer: Queen Elizabeth II, in Ottawa.
10. 1982 憲法包含什麼？答：《加拿大權利與自由憲章》。
10. What did the 1982 Constitution include? Answer: The Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms.
11. 1995 Quebec 公投結果？答：留下 50.6%；獨立 49.4%。
11. What was the result of the 1995 Quebec referendum? Answer: About 50.6% voted to stay, 49.4% to separate.
12. 1969 同性戀除罪化由哪位總理推動？答：皮埃爾・艾略特・杜魯道。
12. Which prime minister decriminalized homosexuality in 1969? Answer: Pierre Elliott Trudeau.
13. 1922 發現胰島素的兩位加拿大科學家？答：弗雷德里克・班廷爵士與查爾斯・貝斯特。
13. Which two Canadian scientists discovered insulin in 1922? Answer: Sir Frederick Banting and Charles Best.
14. 發明電話的加拿大裔蘇格蘭人？答：亞歷山大・格拉漢姆・貝爾。
14. Which Scottish-born Canadian invented the telephone? Answer: Alexander Graham Bell.
15. 發明 Snowmobile 的人？答：約瑟夫－阿爾芒・龐巴迪。
15. Who invented the snowmobile? Answer: Joseph-Armand Bombardier.
16. 全球時區是哪位加拿大人？答：桑福德・弗萊明爵士。
16. Which Canadian invented worldwide standard time zones? Answer: Sir Sandford Fleming.
17. 發明籃球的加拿大人？哪一年？答：詹姆斯・奈史密斯；1891 年。
17. Which Canadian invented basketball, and when? Answer: James Naismith, in 1891.
18. BlackBerry 兩位創辦人？答：麥克・拉扎里迪斯與吉姆・巴爾西利。
18. Who were the two founders of BlackBerry? Answer: Mike Lazaridis and Jim Balsillie.
19. 帶癌截肢跑「希望馬拉松」的英雄？答：泰瑞・福克斯。
19. Who ran the Marathon of Hope after losing a leg to cancer? Answer: Terry Fox.
20. 加拿大太空人 Chris Hadfield 哪一年擔任 ISS 指揮官？答：2013 年。
20. In what year did astronaut Chris Hadfield command the International Space Station? Answer: 2013.
21. 1988 道歉的對象與總理？答：日裔加拿大人；布萊恩・穆隆尼。
21. Who received an apology in 1988, and from which prime minister? Answer: Japanese Canadians; Brian Mulroney.
22. 2006 道歉的對象與總理？答：華工人頭稅；史蒂芬・哈珀。
22. Who received an apology in 2006, and from which prime minister? Answer: Chinese Canadians for the Head Tax; Stephen Harper.
23. 2008 道歉的對象與總理？答：寄宿學校原住民；史蒂芬・哈珀。
23. Who received an apology in 2008, and from which prime minister? Answer: Residential school survivors; Stephen Harper.
24. CBC 哪一年成立？答：1936 年。
24. In what year was the CBC founded? Answer: 1936.
25. 1989 加美自由貿易協定？1994 三方？2020 取代後叫？答：加美自由貿易協定；NAFTA；USMCA／CUSMA。
25. What were the 1989 Canada-U.S. agreement, the 1994 three-way agreement, and the 2020 replacement called? Answer: The Canada-U.S. Free Trade Agreement; NAFTA; USMCA / CUSMA.

第 5 部分 — 政府、選舉、司法（35 題）Chapter 5 — Government, Elections, Justice (35)

1. 加拿大政體三個關鍵詞？答：君主立憲、議會民主、聯邦國家。
1. What are the three key words describing Canada's system of government? Answer: Constitutional monarchy, parliamentary democracy, federal state.
2. 政府 3 層級？答：聯邦、省（地區）、市鎮。
2. What are the three levels of government? Answer: Federal, provincial or territorial, and municipal.
3. 醫療是聯邦還是省？答：省。
3. Is health care a federal or a provincial responsibility? Answer: Provincial.
4. 移民是聯邦還是省？答：聯邦為主，指南列為聯邦與省共同管轄。
4. Is immigration federal or provincial? Answer: Shared, but led federally — the guide lists immigration as a shared jurisdiction.
5. 國會 3 部分？答：君主、參議院、眾議院。
5. What are the three parts of Parliament? Answer: The Sovereign, the Senate and the House of Commons.
6. 現任君主？答：國王查理三世。
6. Who is the current Sovereign? Answer: King Charles III.
7. 在加拿大代表君主的職位？答：總督。
7. Who represents the Sovereign in Canada? Answer: The Governor General.
8. 現任總督？歷史意義？答：瑪麗・西蒙；首位原住民總督（2021 年起）。
8. Who is the current Governor General, and why is that historic? Answer: Mary Simon; the first Indigenous Governor General (since 2021).
9. 參議員如何產生？任期至幾歲？答：由總督依總理建議任命；任職至 75 歲。
9. How are senators chosen, and until what age do they serve? Answer: Appointed by the Governor General on the advice of the Prime Minister; they serve until age 75.
10. 眾議院多少席？任期最多幾年？答：2021 年版指南寫 308 席；席次隨人口增加（查 elections.ca）。任期最多 4 年。
10. How many seats are in the House of Commons, and what is the maximum term? Answer: The 2021 guide says 308; seats grow with the population (check elections.ca). Maximum term four years.
11. 眾議員縮寫？答：MP——國會議員。
11. What is the abbreviation for a member of the House of Commons? Answer: MP — Member of Parliament.
12. 法案立法 7 個階段？答：一讀、二讀、委員會、報告、三讀、參議院、御准。
12. What are the seven stages of a bill becoming law? Answer: First Reading, Second Reading, Committee Stage, Report Stage, Third Reading, Senate, Royal Assent.
13. Royal Assent 由誰簽署？答：總督（代表君主）。
13. Who grants Royal Assent? Answer: The Governor General, on behalf of the Sovereign.
14. 總理如何產生？答：眾議院席次最多政黨的黨魁，由總督邀請組閣。
14. How does someone become Prime Minister? Answer: The leader of the party with the most seats in the House of Commons is invited by the Governor General to form the government.
15. 「Money bills」由哪一院提？答：眾議院。
15. In which chamber are money bills introduced? Answer: The House of Commons.
16. 投票年齡？答：18 歲。
16. What is the voting age? Answer: 18.
17. 大選機構名稱？答：加拿大選舉局。
17. What is the name of the federal election agency? Answer: Elections Canada.
18. 加拿大選區數？答：2021 年版指南寫 308；隨人口增加——考前查 elections.ca。
18. How many electoral districts are there? Answer: The 2021 guide says 308; the number rises with population — check elections.ca before the test.
19. 哪種選制？答：單一選區相對多數決——得票最多者當選。
